epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這一集講述的是一些非常奇怪的動物,我們認為它們可能來自外太空。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This episode is all about animals that are so strange so weird.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本集探討喜歡旅行的動物。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This episode explores animals that like to travel.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 羅裡很想跳舞,因為這一集都是關於動物的腳!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Rory is in the mood for dancing because this episode is all about animal’s feet!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本集講述的是世界上最大的動物。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This episode is all about the biggest animals in the world.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 有人為了讓他們的寵物更好看而十分努力!但野外的情況卻大相逕庭!奇妙的動物在沒有任何幫助下炫耀自己的東西,今天的測驗就是關於這些超級炫耀狂的。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Today’s quiz is all about the Super Show Offs.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 當我們想看看世上正發生甚麼事時—我們用的是眼睛!但我們的眼睛絕對比不上某些動物的奇特視力!這就是為何今天的測驗全都關於優秀的眼球!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Todays quiz is all about animals with Excellent Eyeballs!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 有些動物顏色鮮豔,很容易被看到。但今集我們要看的是喜歡匿藏的動物,這就是為何這個測驗全都關於偽裝大師!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Todays quiz is all about Masters of Disguise!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 我們的腳幫助我們到達想去的地方。但動物可以用它們做出各種各樣的事。今天的測驗是關於神奇的腳!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Todays quiz is all about Fantastic Feet!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 阿米爾王子有一隻新寵物鳥,但牠有點不妥。牠不能飛!在嘗試各種方法幫牠飛後,孩子們對牠有了驚人發現。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Prince Aamil has a new pet bird, but theres something wrong with it. It cant fly! While trying various ways to help the bird fly, the children make a surprising discovery about it.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 孩子們在紅鬍子想挖的藏寶處建造沙堡,結果會如何?誰會得償所願?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: What happens when the kids build their sandcastle at the exact spot that Redbeard wants to dig for treasure?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 比路發現他最好的朋友有音樂天賦。從那一刻起,他將嘗試與其他朋友分享發現。儘管姑毛很害羞,比路還是會嘗試揭露和分享這個秘密。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bello discovers his best friend has an innate talent for music. From that moment on, he will try to share his discovery with the rest of his friends. Despite how shy Goomo is, Bello will try to reveal and share the secret.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《小毛孩大百科》能解答小孩們一直喜愛的動物的疑問。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: ZooMooPedia answers the questions kids have always wanted to know about their favourite animals

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 盧賓浩了解到,他看到任何東西都不能不問是否可以安全食用。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Lubinho learns that he cannot eat anything he sees without asking if its safe to eat.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 嘿! 這是您最喜歡的動物吟遊詩人團體!這是 ZooMoo 樂團! 加入我們的 ZooMoo 朋友們,他們會為我們唱一首關於海狸的輕快曲調!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Its the ZooMoo Band! Join our ZooMoo friends as they sing us a toe-tapping tune all about beavers!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 里奧找到一隻青眼蛺蝶,然後小遊俠出發找出牠的家。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Leo finds a blue pansy caterpillar and the Junior Rangers set off to find its home.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 遊俠洛奇邀請小遊俠一起把殺人鯨放生回海中。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ranger Rocky invites the Junior Rangers along on an adventure to return an orca to the sea.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 小遊俠到南美把一條電鰻放生回家。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Junior Rangers travel to South America to return an electric eel home.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 小遊俠到稀樹草原找一頭東南非獵豹的媽媽。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Junior Rangers journey to the Savannah to find a cheetah cubs mother.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 小遊俠出航找尋一尾鬼蝠鱝的家。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Junior Rangers sail the ocean to find a manta rays home.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 遊俠洛奇委託小遊俠一項任務,把一尾翻車魚帶回海洋。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ranger Rocky entrusts the Junior Rangers with a mission, return a mola to the ocean!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 小遊俠帶著一隻年幼的羅斯柴爾德長頸鹿來到稀樹草原,為牠找一個舒適的家。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Junior Rangers bring a young Rothschilds giraffe to the Savannah to find it a good home.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 小遊俠去到雨林,讓一隻年幼的馬來亞虎跟牠的媽媽團聚。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Junior Rangers travel to the rainforest to reunite a Malayan tiger cub with its mother.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 小遊俠到大海為一條年青的扇貝雙髻鯊找一個家。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Junior Rangers head to the ocean to find a home for a young scalloped hammerhead shark.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 小遊俠前往草原,為東部斑點臭鼬找一個合適的家。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Junior Rangers head to the prairie to find a suitable home for an eastern spotted skunk.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 小遊俠在雨林找一隻馬來亞古龍的媽媽。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Junior Rangers search the rainforest for a Malayan colugos mother.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一隻斑犀鳥需要在雨林找一個家。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: An oriental pied hornbill needs to find its home in the rainforest.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 小遊俠發現了一隻想飛的鴞鸚鵡!只有一個小問題—牠是世上唯一一種不會飛的鸚鵡。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Junior Rangers discover a Kakapo that wishes to fly!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 嘉豪掉進了一個袋熊的洞穴!小遊俠能及時找到他嗎?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Kyle has fallen into a Wombats burrow! Can the Junior Rangers find him in time?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一把神秘的尖叫聲迴盪在塔斯曼尼亞森林中。小遊俠能否解救被困在深溝中的煩躁袋獾?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Can the Junior Rangers rescue the feisty Tasmanian Devil trapped in a deep trench?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 嘉豪聲稱發現了一種全新的動物物種—它有水獺的皮毛和身體、鴨子的蹼足和喙,以及海狸一樣的尾巴。嘉豪獸需要幫助!

epg.episode_synopsis_en: When Ray accidentally destroys Henrys dads prized remote control car, they throw a manicure/pedicure party to raise money to fix it.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 超能勢力在好景市國中表現優良,但雷很想念他的跟班,想把他們從學校帶走.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Danger Force is crushing it at Swellview Junior High, but Ray misses his sidekicks and schemes to get them out of school.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 大夥們發現路伯特曾是個快樂的年輕人,還跟一個美女訂了婚,他們決心幫助這對分手的戀人重逢.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: When the gang discovers that Lewbert was once a happy young man engaged to a beautiful woman, they set out to reunite the lost lovers.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 阿珊告訴卡莉和佛萊迪,她小時候參加過選美賽,當她得知她的長期死對頭要到西雅圖比賽,她說服卡莉也參賽跟她競爭.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Sam reveals to Carly and Freddie that she used to compete in pageants as a young girl. When she learns that her long-time rival will be competing in Seattle, she convinces Carly to compete against her

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: When April Fools Day comes to Hollywood Arts, Tori spends her day expecting creative pranks and practical jokes, while being oblivious to a series of absurd events and crazy happenings around her.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: When April Fools Day comes to Hollywood Arts, Tori spends her day expecting creative pranks and practical jokes, while being oblivious to a series of absurd events and crazy happenings around her.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 凱特發明一個節日,「耶耶節」,那是讓人買禮物給所有人的藉口.凱特偷看別人送她的禮物時,發現阿珊送了很侮辱人的禮物.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Cat invents a holiday, Yay Day, which is just an excuse to buy presents for everyone. When Cat snoops what other people have gotten her, she discovers an insulting present from Sam.

epg.programme_title_tc: 忍者龜之都市傳奇 [英/普]
epg.programme_title_en: Tales of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles [Eng/Man]
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 米奇跟成吉思娃在暴風雨中出任務,前往當地超市購買日用品,結果遇到了電鰻李,米奇得挺身而出,擔當領導重任!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mikey and Genghis Frog are sent into the storm on a supply run to the local market when they encounter the electrifying LEE THE EEL! Now Mikey has to step up and be a LEADER!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 被譽為“屍語者的法醫秦明常可在屍體身上解剖出重要的線索。在調查一宗謀殺案時,秦明在實習助手和刑警隊長的協助下發現了塵封16年的雪山殺人案,同時亦揭發離奇謀殺案背後隱藏著的秘密。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Renowned as the corpse whisperer, forensic pathologist Qin Ming uncovers vital clues from the corpses. During a homicide investigation, he unravels a murder case sixteen years ago in the snowy mountain with his assistant and a detective. Together, they unveil the secrets of the mysterious homicide.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在朋友去世後,一群年輕人前往倫敦郊外的一座別墅,這裡隱藏著撲朔迷離的謎團。隨著度假期間詭異事件不斷發生,他們必須揭開別墅深藏的黑暗秘密。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Following the death of their friend, a group of young adults travels to a villa on the outskirts of London that contains a deep mystery. As unsettling events escalate during their luxurious stay, they must unravel the villa’s dark secrets.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 菲律賓警方調查一宗極其殘忍、涉及邪教祭祀的離奇連環屠殺案時,在薄荷島救出唯一的倖存者,而她竟是一名隱姓埋名的前美國FBI探員。隨著調查不斷深入,她供述的遠古預言、惡魔附身與血腥祭祀,逐漸將所有人捲入一..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: While investigating a series of cult ritual massacres, Philippine police rescue the sole survivor on Bohol Island, who is a former FBI agent living under a false identity. As the investigation deepens, her accounts of ancient prophecies, demonic possession and bloody rituals draw everyone into a terrifying mystery where reality blurs.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在迷霧村,為人養子的文傑反復夢見同一個噩夢。為了解開身世之謎,他捲入連串神秘的失蹤案件中。隨著更多村民相繼離奇死去,村民更深信不疑千年來的井龍王詛咒。於是,文傑與保安隊長聯手探尋真相,揭開反派陰謀,最..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Misty Village, the adopted son Wen Jie is haunted by a recurring nightmare. He delves into a series of disappearance cases in the village to seek his true identity. As more villagers die mysteriously, belief in the curse of Emperor Jing Lung intensifies. Wen Jie teams up with the security chief to unveil the conspiracy and protect the villagers.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 美國加州Ojai鎮流傳著一處神秘的「惡魔漩渦」,據說凡是踏入其禁地的人,都將被黑暗力量吞噬。六段彼此交織的恐怖故事,逐步揭開這股邪惡力量的真相,以及一棟遭受詛咒的房屋與歷代住戶無法逃離的駭人命運。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Ojai, California, a mysterious spiritual vortex is said to unleash dark forces upon anyone who enters its domain. Through six interconnected horror tales, the terrifying secrets of a cursed house and its doomed inhabitants are revealed, exposing the sinister power lurking behind the Devils Vortex.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一個單親媽媽郁香和她的女兒童童搬進了一個住宅區展開新生活。區內住著一個個看似幸福美滿的家庭,背後卻藏著許多不為人知的秘密,而人性的黑暗面亦一步步被揭開. . .
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A single-parent family (Yu Xiang and Tong Tong) moves into a new neighbourhood where everyone’s life seems perfect.  However, while things may look rosy on the outside, dark secrets and horror raid each family from the inside, and nothing really are as they seem.

epg.programme_title_tc: Anak Perjanjian Syaitan 2 (aka Offspring of the Devils Pact 2)
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 孤兒Azlinda從小就受到鬼魂的困擾,相信這些折磨與父母的暗黑歷史密切相關。她的朋友Zurina、Wati和Ustaz攜手合作,希望結束她的痛苦,但卻被一個邪惡的惡魔阻撓。Azlinda能否成功斬斷..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Haunted since childhood, orphan Azlinda believes her torment stems from her parents dark history. Her friends Zurina, Wati, and Ustaz join forces to end her suffering, but a malevolent demon interrupts their efforts. Will Azlinda succeed in severing the cursed ties that bind her, or is she destined to remain trapped in darkness forever?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一位記者調查二十年前紙人回魂案時,聽到三個關於恐怖紙人的故事。故事起源於喬府大小姐喬媛媛枉死後,管家請紙紮匠為小姐做了紙人陪葬。紙人被點眼睛後,大小姐得以借紙人回魂復仇,更接二連三引發連串與紙人有關的..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A reporter hears three horror stories when investigating a case of the paper doll spirit 20 years ago. Miss Qiao had died in vain then, and her butler paid a paper craftsman to make a paper doll to be buried with her. Miss Qiao’s spirit is revived to take revenge when the doll’s eyes are drawn, and a series of horrible events begins to happen...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 當年輕的Evie在海灘上發現一條受詛咒的項鍊時,她並未察覺其中隱藏的邪惡力量。隨著項鍊的暗黑力量逐漸侵蝕她的意志,她無意中喚醒了恐怖的水魔,而這個水魔將威脅到她和她所愛之人的性命。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: When young Evie discovers a cursed necklace washed up on the beach, she is unaware of the malevolent force tied to it. As the necklaces dark power begins to grip her, she inadvertently awakens a deadly water demon intent on claiming her and everyone she holds dear.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 警方在調查一宗團夥殺人案時,突然又發生了離奇的紙人殺人事件,嫌疑人一個接一個被殺。隨著不斷挖出的線索,警方最終發現這背後隱藏著橫跨兩代人的秘密與悲劇。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: As the police investigate a gang murder case, another mysterious paper man murder occurs, and the suspects are killed one by one. Continuing to track the clues of the case, the police finally unveil a hidden secret and tragedy spanning two generations.

epg.programme_title_tc: Blood Hunters: Rise of the Hybrids
epg.programme_title_en: Blood Hunters: Rise of the Hybrids
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 女戰士Gabriella的家人慘死於異種怪物之手,她矢志復仇,成為血獵手。一次爆炸中,她身受重傷,被Max與Kali所救,並加入他們的獵手聯盟。得知異種惡魔即將發動襲擊,眾人先發制人突襲巢穴,試圖阻止..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After a hybrid monster slaughters her family, Gabriella becomes a Blood Hunter bent on revenge. Caught in an explosion, she is wounded and rescued by hunters Max and Kali, then joins their group. When they learn hybrid demons are planning an attack, the hunters strike first, raiding their lair to prevent disaster, only to fall into a deadly trap.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: After a hybrid monster slaughters her family, Gabriella becomes a Blood Hunter bent on revenge. Caught in an explosion, she is wounded and rescued by hunters Max and Kali, then joins their group. When they learn hybrid demons are planning an attack, the hunters strike first, raiding their lair to prevent disaster, only to fall into a deadly trap.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一個單親媽媽郁香和她的女兒童童搬進了一個住宅區展開新生活。區內住著一個個看似幸福美滿的家庭,背後卻藏著許多不為人知的秘密,而人性的黑暗面亦一步步被揭開. . .
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A single-parent family (Yu Xiang and Tong Tong) moves into a new neighbourhood where everyone’s life seems perfect.  However, while things may look rosy on the outside, dark secrets and horror raid each family from the inside, and nothing really are as they seem.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 為逃離家暴陰影,Jennifer搬進212號公寓展開新生活,卻每天醒來身上出現詭異且疼痛的咬痕。她驚覺牆內潛藏著以活人血肉為食的古老寄生怪物。隨著襲擊加劇,面對這場嗜肉噩夢,她必須在被徹底蠶食之前,鼓..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Escaping an abusive past, Jennifer moves into Apartment 212 for a fresh start, only to wake each day with painful bite marks. She soon discovers an ancient parasite that feeds on human flesh lurking within the walls. As attacks intensify, she must confront a nightmare more terrifying than her past before it consumes her.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟朋友在酒吧喝酒的女孩邂逅恐怖小說家,兩人一見鍾情感情迅速升溫。原來女孩已悄然落入驚天迷局,全因小說家的前女友是個毀容的女鬼,她借用人面還魂復仇,與前男友聯手開啟奪命驚嚇。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A young girl encounters a novelist in a bar and quickly falls in love with him. However, it turns out she has fallen into a trap set up by the novelist and his ex-girlfriend who is a ghost with a disfigured face. The journey of revenge and ultimate terror has just begun!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 全球暖化解凍遠古冰層,釋出一股邪惡孢子,為人類帶來毀滅浩劫。逃難中的Meadow躲進一間廢棄小屋,卻發現自己並非孤身一人。她必須與其他倖存者並肩求生,因為感染者正蛻變為饑渴的獵人,對活人展開殘酷獵殺。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Global warming has awakened a malevolent spore from beneath an ancient ice field, unleashing a horrific plague that ravages humanity. Fleeing the chaos, Meadow takes refuge in an abandoned cabin. Together with other strangers, she fights to survive as some succumb to the plague, transforming into ravenous hunters who now stalk the living.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 思南和丈夫前往吉隆玻度假,希望能緩解懷孕帶來的壓力。然而,她意外發現丈夫有個陰險的計畫,要將他們的孩子變成「碌葛」以謀取利潤,使她陷入危險之中。思南幸得酒店鬼魂的幫助,成功逃脫並報警將丈夫拘捕,最終安..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Si Nan and her husband travel to Kuala Lumpur for a vacation to relieve her pregnancy stress. However, she soon uncovers his evil plan to turn their child into a Luk Krok for profit, which puts her in grave danger. With the help of the hotel ghosts, she manages to flee and alert the police to arrest him, finally giving birth to her child.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 幾位朋友邀請保羅參加在學校天台舉行的秘密派對。當保羅因一場惡作劇而意外身亡時,這群朋友決定隱瞞此事,並承諾會永遠保密。保羅誓要復仇,並變成厲鬼把他們嚇翻,讓他們為自己的行為負責。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A group of friends invites Paul to a secret party on their campus rooftop. When a prank accidentally kills Paul, the friends cover up the incident and promised never to disclose it. Paul vows to take revenge by becoming a vicious ghost to haunt them into taking responsibility for their actions.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 失明的游己任在離島的工廠工作。一天,因颶風的破壞,工廠與外界隔絕。此時突然有一隻怪物來襲,任何看到怪物的人都會化成黑影。因游己任看不見怪物,他能成功協助夥伴安全離開,更奮戰反擊,誓要殺死怪物!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: You Ji Ren is a blind man who works at a factory on an outlying island. When the factory is cut off from the outside world by a hurricane one day, a monster appears and turns whoever sees it into black shadows. As You cannot see the monster, he is able to help his other co-workers escape safely and fight to kill the monster.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 幼女離奇失蹤後,悲痛的Drew與Helen在治療師安排下,前往偏遠林中小屋接受深度諮商。隨著孤立與壓抑逐漸侵蝕理智,療癒之旅化為噩夢。Helen飽受詭異幻象與異象困擾,逐漸分不清現實與幻覺,心智瀕臨崩..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After their young daughter’s mysterious disappearance, Drew and Helen retreat to a secluded woodland cottage for therapy. As they struggle to salvage their marriage, isolation fractures their sanity. Haunted by visions and strange events, Helen can no longer tell what is real as her mind unravels.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 三位網紅相約前往荒島直播旅行,途中遭一名神秘老婦誘騙至偏遠孤島。原來這是一場精心策劃的陷阱,她們竟成了老婦為傷殘孫兒物色新娘的獵物。面對日益瘋狂的囚禁與威脅,她們必須爭分奪秒逃離這座噩夢孤島。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Three KOLs embark on a live-streaming trip to a remote island. However, they are deceived by a mysterious old woman who traps them, intending to find brides for her disabled grandsons. As they realise they have been captured, they must race against time to escape this nightmare island.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 電影由三個恐怖短故事組成:一個男人收到死神通報後,設法避過死亡;男人因心愛的妻子去世後傷心欲絕,他的妻子變成鬼魂與他通靈;三兄弟在一次晚餐聚會上為照顧年邁母親的問題而爭吵,最後竟變成一宗可怕的謀殺案。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The film consists of three short horror stories: a man tries to survive after he received a haunted mail predicting his death; while a man mourns the death of his beloved wife, she becomes a ghost and tries to communicate with him; three brothers clash over the care options of their elderly mother during dinner, leading to a terrifying murder.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 五名大學生受委派前往一座神祕莊園進行專題研究,並結識了上流名媛莎拉吉夫人,卻發現她隱藏著致命祕密。隨著她的惡魔力量逐漸覺醒,原本的學術之旅瞬間化為生死逃亡,他們必須對抗統治階層延續數百年的詛咒。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Five university students are assigned a project at a mysterious estate, where they meet Lady Salakjit, an elite socialite with a deadly secret. As her demonic powers surface, their academic trip turns into a frantic struggle for survival against a centuries-old curse of the ruling class.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 幼女離奇失蹤後,悲痛的Drew與Helen在治療師安排下,前往偏遠林中小屋接受深度諮商。隨著孤立與壓抑逐漸侵蝕理智,療癒之旅化為噩夢。Helen飽受詭異幻象與異象困擾,逐漸分不清現實與幻覺,心智瀕臨崩..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After their young daughter’s mysterious disappearance, Drew and Helen retreat to a secluded woodland cottage for therapy. As they struggle to salvage their marriage, isolation fractures their sanity. Haunted by visions and strange events, Helen can no longer tell what is real as her mind unravels.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 三位網紅相約前往荒島直播旅行,途中遭一名神秘老婦誘騙至偏遠孤島。原來這是一場精心策劃的陷阱,她們竟成了老婦為傷殘孫兒物色新娘的獵物。面對日益瘋狂的囚禁與威脅,她們必須爭分奪秒逃離這座噩夢孤島。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Three KOLs embark on a live-streaming trip to a remote island. However, they are deceived by a mysterious old woman who traps them, intending to find brides for her disabled grandsons. As they realise they have been captured, they must race against time to escape this nightmare island.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 電影由三個恐怖短故事組成:一個男人收到死神通報後,設法避過死亡;男人因心愛的妻子去世後傷心欲絕,他的妻子變成鬼魂與他通靈;三兄弟在一次晚餐聚會上為照顧年邁母親的問題而爭吵,最後竟變成一宗可怕的謀殺案。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The film consists of three short horror stories: a man tries to survive after he received a haunted mail predicting his death; while a man mourns the death of his beloved wife, she becomes a ghost and tries to communicate with him; three brothers clash over the care options of their elderly mother during dinner, leading to a terrifying murder.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 五名大學生受委派前往一座神祕莊園進行專題研究,並結識了上流名媛莎拉吉夫人,卻發現她隱藏著致命祕密。隨著她的惡魔力量逐漸覺醒,原本的學術之旅瞬間化為生死逃亡,他們必須對抗統治階層延續數百年的詛咒。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Five university students are assigned a project at a mysterious estate, where they meet Lady Salakjit, an elite socialite with a deadly secret. As her demonic powers surface, their academic trip turns into a frantic struggle for survival against a centuries-old curse of the ruling class.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 全職媽媽Mary因丈夫調職,獨自提前搬入美國南方新居打點一切。小鎮的寧靜雖令她愜意,怪事卻接連發生,多名年輕人相繼離奇失蹤。每當黃昏,一輛老舊冰淇淋車便會響起歡快的童謠。Mary震驚地發現,看似溫文儒..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mary moves into their new home in the South ahead of her family, following her husband’s relocation. She enjoys the quiet town, but young people start disappearing. An old ice cream truck plays a cheerful tune each evening. Mary discovers its gentle-seeming driver is a serial killer targeting local youth, and she is next on his list.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc:
民國年間,江南村落接連發生離奇命案,逐漸淪為遠近聞名的鬼村「封門村」。記者李穆與員警萬楓為追查一宗滅門慘案,深入陰森村莊抽絲剝繭,
誓要揭開連環命案背後的真相,破除流傳已久的封建迷信。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: During the Republican era, a Jiangnan village plagued by mysterious deaths becomes the infamous ghost village of Fengmen. Journalist Li Mu and police officer Wan Feng venture into the eerie village to uncover the truth behind the killings and shatter the grip of superstition.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 建築師May與男友Gun搬入新居後,驟聞繼母離奇身亡。May收留孤苦的繼妹Noon,怎料她入宅後竟行為詭異,頻遭惡靈附身,而May也陷入恐怖幻象與嚴重失眠的折磨。隨著宅內黑暗秘密逐步揭開,通靈法師終於..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After moving into a house with her boyfriend, Gun, architect May learns of her stepmother’s mysterious death. When May takes in her stepsister Noon, the girl begins showing signs of possession, while May suffers disturbing visions and insomnia. As dark secrets emerge, spiritual masters uncover an ancient black-magic curse hidden within the house.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 謝毅忠年少時跳童請神,請來的竟是大伯爺白無常,釀成一場無法挽回的悲劇,自此再也不敢請神。多年後重返故鄉,村中詭異怪事接連發生,至親性命危在旦夕。面對邪靈作祟,他能否再次請神出煞,化解這場生死劫難?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: As a boy, Xie Yi Zhong performed a spirit-summoning ritual and accidentally invoked Bai Wu Chang, the White Reaper, triggering a tragedy. Years later, he returns home to find his hometown plagued by eerie events and his loved ones lives at stake. Will he dare summon the spirit again to confront the evil forces?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 傑米的妻子在車禍中不幸喪生的一年後,他游說妻子的妹妹與他一起返回事故現場,進行一場古怪的儀式。隨著夜幕低垂,傑米明顯有行兇的動機。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A year after Jamies wife tragically died in a car accident, he persuades her sister, Ava, to accompany him to the accident site to perform a peculiar ritual. As the night progresses, it becomes evident that Jamie harbours sinister motives.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: A year after Jamies wife tragically died in a car accident, he persuades her sister, Ava, to accompany him to the accident site to perform a peculiar ritual. As the night progresses, it becomes evident that Jamie harbours sinister motives.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 若為和兩位閨蜜回到她兒時居住的房子,重遇一直住在那兒的表哥。他們本打算一起散散心,卻頻頻遭遇靈異事件的侵襲,最後更變成一場驚心動魄之旅,有讓人意想不到的結局。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ruo Wei returns to her childhood home with two best friends, and reunites with her cousin who has always lived there. While they plan to enjoy their trip, they are constantly haunted by paranormal events, ending up in a terrifying experience with unexpected outcome.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 依成和朋友到聚魂靈山探險,傳說山中埋著千年女屍,千年不滅之陰火,進去的人都逃不出來。淩晨兩點半,依成的朋友先後突然消失。在森林搜索期間,依成進入無限輪回的靈異空間,更恐怖的事情卻接踵而來…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Yi Cheng and his friends venture into a haunted mountain that hides an ancient corpse and an eternal ghostly flame. No one who enters the mountain ever returns and at 2:30 AM, Yi Cheng’s friends vanish one by one. While searching for them in the eerie forest, Yi Cheng enters a realm of infinite reincarnation, facing a series of terrifying events…

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Jennifer參加了一個探索荷蘭著名風車的旅行團。在途中,旅遊巴發生故障,迫使他們住進一所陰森的小屋,附近更有座可怕的風車。當部分團友突然離奇失蹤時,Jennifer發現他們之間隱藏著一個共同的秘密..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jennifer joins a tour to explore the renowned windmills of the Netherlands. As their tour coach breaks down on the way, they seek refuge in a creepy shed near a sinister windmill with a dark history. When some tour members suddenly disappear, Jennifer discovers a shared secret among them, linking their fates in a chilling revelation.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 當年輕母親為女兒莫名失蹤而苦惱時,一連串怪異的事件接踵而至。這都可能與二十年前的意外亡魂為復仇歸來有關…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: As a young mother grapples with her daughters mysterious disappearance, a series of eerie events unfold. These events could be linked to the vengeful ghosts of a tragic accident that happened 20 years ago...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 7個朋友踏上旅程,前往村長和女兒Suri經營的偏遠平房。他們舉行派對,並請求Suri擔任侍應。隨著派對逐漸失控,Suri不幸遭強暴。在自殺前,她對這7個人施下咒怨,使他們受到惡夢的纏擾。隨著這7人一個..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: 7 friends go on a road trip to a remote bungalow run by a village head and his daughter Suri. They host a party and ask Suri to help. Things spiral out of control and Suri is raped. Before killing herself, she curses them to be haunted in their dreams. As the friends are killed off one by one, they must break the curse to escape their deadly fate.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 若為和兩位閨蜜回到她兒時居住的房子,重遇一直住在那兒的表哥。他們本打算一起散散心,卻頻頻遭遇靈異事件的侵襲,最後更變成一場驚心動魄之旅,有讓人意想不到的結局。

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 7個朋友踏上旅程,前往村長和女兒Suri經營的偏遠平房。他們舉行派對,並請求Suri擔任侍應。隨著派對逐漸失控,Suri不幸遭強暴。在自殺前,她對這7個人施下咒怨,使他們受到惡夢的纏擾。隨著這7人一個..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: 7 friends go on a road trip to a remote bungalow run by a village head and his daughter Suri. They host a party and ask Suri to help. Things spiral out of control and Suri is raped. Before killing herself, she curses them to be haunted in their dreams. As the friends are killed off one by one, they must break the curse to escape their deadly fate.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 書生王懷卿賣畫,為要籌藥費救患重病的妻子,途中意外遇上雀妖的追擊,幸得狐妖小容相救。為躲避雀妖,王懷卿將小容帶回家中,三人隨即陷入一場情感困局,而一段淒美的人妖虐戀亦隨即展開。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Scholar Wang Huai Qing sells paintings to save his ailing wife. He is attacked by a bird demon along the way but is rescued by Fox demon Xiao Rong. To elude the pursuit, Wang brings Xiao Rong home, sparking a love triangle and at the same time, unfolding an impending love between human and demon.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 鬼妻娜娜再次回歸,為一名遭受性侵導致流產的孕婦報仇。除鬼妻娜娜外,沒有人能認出襲擊者的身份。娜娜為報仇變成厲鬼,並要懲罰襲擊者的惡行。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mae Nak the ghost wife returns to take revenge for a pregnant woman who is sexually assaulted and loses her baby. No one can identify the assailant except Mae Nak, who turns into an evil spirit in order to punish the assailant for his evil deeds.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 父親去世後,Nathan和妹妹回到祖家準備出售房子。在此期間,Nathan發現這處房產是從兩名曾被指控濫用巫術的女子的祖先手中偷來的。隨著他深入調查,揭開了一個與父親死亡相關的神秘陰謀,而這個陰謀如今..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After their fathers death, Nathan and his sister return to their family home to prepare it for sale. While there, Nathan discovers that the land was stolen from the ancestors of two women accused of witchcraft. As he delves deeper, he uncovers an occult conspiracy linked to their fathers death which now threatens them both.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 家豪和朋友在別墅裡舉辦生日派對,卻意外地連接上了恐怖的虛擬實境遊戲《七夜》。原本歡樂的慶祝活動瞬間變成了一場令人恐懼的經歷。為了生存,他們必須在遊戲中點燃蠟燭,並小心避開遊蕩的鬼魂。隨著他的兩位朋友相..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jia Hao and his friends gather to celebrate his birthday at a villa. However, the festivities take a dark turn when they connect to a deadly VR game in which they must light candles and dodge ghosts to survive. Tragedy strikes as two of his friends fall victim to the escalating horrors within, plunging them all deeper into a chilling nightmare.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一個寧靜的晚上,一名患精神病的連環殺手擾亂了年輕夫婦的平淡生活。當這對夫婦為生存而戰時,他們隱藏多年的秘密亦隨之揭開,期間更意外地被牽連到黑社會的地下世界中。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A young couples tranquility is shattered by a psychotic serial killer one quiet evening. Their battle for survival reveals hidden truths, entangling them unwittingly with the criminal underworld.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 四名好友在一座古老宅邸重聚,出席一場葬禮,因一時魯莽觸碰被詛咒的瑪諾拉舞者頭飾,意外喚醒如影隨形的厲鬼。隨著靈異現象接連發生,他們被迫揭開宅邸深藏的黑暗秘密,在絕望中展開一場與惡靈的求生之戰。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: When four best friends reunite for a funeral at an ancient estate, a reckless act with a cursed Manohra dancers headdress awakens a vengeful spirit that begins to haunt and follow them relentlessly. As paranormal phenomena escalate, they are forced to confront the estates dark secrets in a desperate struggle for survival.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 消失三年的鬼手及其盜墓團夥重現江城,再次下墓摸金。怎料四名盜墓賊在開棺時遇驚魂邪煞,逃離後又接連慘死家中。最終古墓屍毒和針孔成為留給員警沈春合僅有的線索,看似普通的盜墓案,瞬間撲朔迷離疑點重重。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ghost Hand and his tomb raiders resurface in Jiang City to seek gold in ancient tombs after a 3-year absence. They released an evil spirit from a coffin and all four died at home eventually. Poison and pinholes in the corpses become the sole clue for police investigation. A tomb raid now unfolds as a perplexing and mysterious case.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Amy和養子Adrian逃離了虐待她的前女友Judith,躲在Amy堪薩斯家鄉的一棟廢棄農舍中,卻遭遇到因Amy的暗黑歷史所引發的邪惡超自然力量,讓Adrian感到恐懼。當Judith步步進逼時,Am..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Amy and her adopted son Adrian flee from her abusive ex-girlfriend Judith. Seeking refuge in an abandoned farmhouse in Amys Kansas hometown, they confront a supernatural evil force from her dark past that haunts Adrian. As Judith pursues them, Amy and Adrian must face the dangers both outside and within the house.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一場車禍後,林月家裡怪事連連。全身冰冷的姐姐在鏡子裡看不見家人的身影,黑夜裡爸爸窺探的雙眼,和每天淩晨閣樓傳來的彈珠聲。林月循聲而上去尋找真相,卻在打開閣樓的門後,發現裡面緊鎖的是自己的遺像…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Strange incidents keep happening in Lin Yues house after a car accident: her sister cannot see the images of her family members in the mirror; her father is peeping at night; and there is the sound of marbles from the attic every day at dawn. Following the sound to the attic, Lin Yue finds her own death portrait as she opens the door...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在一個沿海小鎮,Rico與Sisca發展了一段不可能的戀情,卻因他們相愛而引發惡靈的出現。隨著整個城鎮發生連串駭人聽聞的死亡事件,也揭露了隱藏多年的秘密,使到整個城鎮被一股恐怖力量所控制。Rico必需..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In a coastal town, a forbidden romance sparks between Rico and Sisca, and their love unleashes a malevolent spirit. As chilling deaths plague the town, past secrets are being unraveled and the town is possessed by evil and fear. Rico must defy destiny and fight against the evil spirit to save his loved one.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一位記者調查二十年前紙人回魂案時,聽到三個關於恐怖紙人的故事。故事起源於喬府大小姐喬媛媛枉死後,管家請紙紮匠為小姐做了紙人陪葬。紙人被點眼睛後,大小姐得以借紙人回魂復仇,更接二連三引發連串與紙人有關的..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A reporter hears three horror stories when investigating a case of the paper doll spirit 20 years ago. Miss Qiao had died in vain then, and her butler paid a paper craftsman to make a paper doll to be buried with her. Miss Qiao’s spirit is revived to take revenge when the doll’s eyes are drawn, and a series of horrible events begins to happen...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 消失三年的鬼手及其盜墓團夥重現江城,再次下墓摸金。怎料四名盜墓賊在開棺時遇驚魂邪煞,逃離後又接連慘死家中。最終古墓屍毒和針孔成為留給員警沈春合僅有的線索,看似普通的盜墓案,瞬間撲朔迷離疑點重重。

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Strange incidents keep happening in Lin Yues house after a car accident: her sister cannot see the images of her family members in the mirror; her father is peeping at night; and there is the sound of marbles from the attic every day at dawn. Following the sound to the attic, Lin Yue finds her own death portrait as she opens the door...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在一個沿海小鎮,Rico與Sisca發展了一段不可能的戀情,卻因他們相愛而引發惡靈的出現。隨著整個城鎮發生連串駭人聽聞的死亡事件,也揭露了隱藏多年的秘密,使到整個城鎮被一股恐怖力量所控制。Rico必需..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In a coastal town, a forbidden romance sparks between Rico and Sisca, and their love unleashes a malevolent spirit. As chilling deaths plague the town, past secrets are being unraveled and the town is possessed by evil and fear. Rico must defy destiny and fight against the evil spirit to save his loved one.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一位記者調查二十年前紙人回魂案時,聽到三個關於恐怖紙人的故事。故事起源於喬府大小姐喬媛媛枉死後,管家請紙紮匠為小姐做了紙人陪葬。紙人被點眼睛後,大小姐得以借紙人回魂復仇,更接二連三引發連串與紙人有關的..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A reporter hears three horror stories when investigating a case of the paper doll spirit 20 years ago. Miss Qiao had died in vain then, and her butler paid a paper craftsman to make a paper doll to be buried with her. Miss Qiao’s spirit is revived to take revenge when the doll’s eyes are drawn, and a series of horrible events begins to happen...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一位渴望成名的作家為了挽救低迷的事業,決心創作一部暢銷小說。他重返童年故居,這裡亦是其身為知名作家的父親當年神秘身亡之地。當他意外發現父親留下的最後手稿時,才驚覺這部作品遠超自己的才華。於是,他決定將..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A struggling writer retreats to his childhood home to finish a novel and save his career. There, he uncovers the final manuscript left behind by his father, a famous writer who died mysteriously years earlier. Realizing the work is beyond his own talent, he decides to plagiarize it, unleashing horrifying supernatural events.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 豔麗女模余虹敏在一間盛傳鬧鬼的廢棄醫院中離奇身亡。事後,她生前的攝影師不斷接到如怨靈索命般的詭異來電,合作撰稿人突遭嚴重車禍,而她的摯友亦突然離奇失蹤。一連串毛骨悚然的怪事接踵而來,彷彿死者充滿妒恨的..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Model Min dies mysteriously in a hospital rumoured to be haunted. Soon after, her photographer receives eerie phone calls, a writer suffers a bizarre car accident, and Min’s friend suddenly vanishes. As fear spreads, dark secrets and supernatural forces emerge, drawing them into a terrifying nightmare linked to Min’s death.

epg.programme_title_tc: Hide  Seek (aka The Last Hide  Seek)
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 七名好友童年時在一棟廢棄大樓玩捉迷藏,卻意外害死了NuAon。十三年後,舊址改建成大學校園,這群年輕人竟再次聚首。當校園接連爆發無法解釋的靈異命案,一名酷似NuAon的白衣厲鬼悄然現身,眾人被迫重返這..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: As children, seven friends played hide-and-seek in an abandoned building, where a tragic accident claimed Nu Aons life. Thirteen years later, the site is now a university, and they reunite. When supernatural murders begin and a ghostly figure resembling Nu Aon appears, they are forced back into a deadly game of hide-and-seek.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 美國加州Ojai鎮流傳著一處神秘的「惡魔漩渦」,據說凡是踏入其禁地的人,都將被黑暗力量吞噬。六段彼此交織的恐怖故事,逐步揭開這股邪惡力量的真相,以及一棟遭受詛咒的房屋與歷代住戶無法逃離的駭人命運。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Ojai, California, a mysterious spiritual vortex is said to unleash dark forces upon anyone who enters its domain. Through six interconnected horror tales, the terrifying secrets of a cursed house and its doomed inhabitants are revealed, exposing the sinister power lurking behind the Devils Vortex.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 攝影師陳志成長年被一名「紅衣女子」糾纏,導致多位親人慘死;甚至連自己心儀的女孩思桐亦難逃惡運。志成欲尋找思桐慘死的真相,卻揭發關於一場「冥婚」的秘密...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Photographer Zhi Cheng is entangled with a woman in red, leading to the deaths of his relatives one by one. When the girl he likes, Si Tong, also dies mysteriously, Zhi Cheng vows to find out the truth but ends up revealing the secret of a ghost marriage...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一位渴望成名的作家為了挽救低迷的事業,決心創作一部暢銷小說。他重返童年故居,這裡亦是其身為知名作家的父親當年神秘身亡之地。當他意外發現父親留下的最後手稿時,才驚覺這部作品遠超自己的才華。於是,他決定將..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A struggling writer retreats to his childhood home to finish a novel and save his career. There, he uncovers the final manuscript left behind by his father, a famous writer who died mysteriously years earlier. Realizing the work is beyond his own talent, he decides to plagiarize it, unleashing horrifying supernatural events.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 富家子趙金龍與賽彩鳳情投意合，龍為了試探鳳，在表哥馬明德幫助下，對鳳裝窮試其真情。鳳遭勢利父親逼婚，好友黎英請明裝作鳳的情人，明因英答允假扮龍之女友，故同意幫忙。連串謊言雖被拆穿，但龍與彩終亦成眷屬。
麥中昌投軍後，其兄麥伯和假傳昌死訊奪家產。和妻甘氏指使張器劫和，器卻誤殺和，於是甘氏嫁禍給昌妻李玉娥。甘氏與知府胡恩有染，娥被判處斬。昌立功當官歸來欲重審案件，恩拒並即行刑，幸器良心發現，娥沉冤得雪。
馬祥與李核、天娜兄妹得萬事通所聘，祥被派往照顧病重的富翁周公。周公的侄兒大偉及其妹等人覬覦周公家財，幸祥盡心照顧，周公病情好轉，憤而趕偉等人離去。偉誘核吸毒，更逼娜色誘周公繼而勒索，祥得悉後報警救人。
李家駒對與表嫂葉曼絲外貌相似的施曼珠一見傾心。絲因丈夫汪繼昌嗜賭，憤而離家，眾人誤將珠帶回家。駒在昌家遇上珠，卻誤認是絲。珠以絲身份試探駒，卻被昌誤會，時絲母帶絲回家，認出珠是絲的孿生妹妹，誤會盡消。
陳佩娥為家境所逼而嫁富商劉紹基為妾，婚後受基妻逼害，苦不堪言。娥本與鄭中堅相戀，堅為掙錢出外謀生，並允諾回來娶娥。數年後，堅欲與娥重新開始，基得悉後與堅爭執，混亂間娥被車撞倒。基知錯，惜娥已返魂乏術。

epg.programme_title_en: Affection and Hatred of the Knight
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 秦明命女兒少華押運鏢銀，華巧遇馬雲龍，暗生情愫。蓋雄彪與女兒馬素貞為投靠黑風堡，偷走華的鏢銀，華闖黑風堡卻被擒。明領人攻打黑風堡，龍被彪所騙，向明出手。明向龍言明真相，龍終殺彪為父報仇，貞為救龍而死。

epg.programme_title_en: When a Lovely Girl Bestows Her
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 辛鳳英一家在梁百芬的公司工作，二人偶遇，英及家人不知芬是其老闆，向芬訴苦。英誤以為芬生活捉襟見肘，為他安排工作，芬決定「微服出巡」。芬得悉公司種種問題，即提出改革，並向英及其家人表明身分後，向英求婚。

epg.programme_title_en: Story of Tin Ngai Fong Cho, The
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 兵荒馬亂，柳天涯與梁芳草約定戰後共諧連理。程雨庭長子早逝，庭逼草入門為媳。戰事結束，涯得知草被逼冥婚一事，於是伺機混入程家。庭為草立貞節牌匾，草與涯在鄉民們前控訴庭，庭眼見群情洶湧，終醒悟，成全二人。
胡人入侵馬家村，馬明章之父被賣國土豪彭冬發手下打死，章被逐出村。章妻林淑英為生計當發女小碧的乳娘，與章分離。多年後，章派兩名兒子往馬家村打探，兩子被擒。英與碧幫忙救人，碧最終更化解了彭、馬兩家的仇怨。
黑幫厲以彪的珠寶疑遭顧大強搶去，彪找金震宇合作把珠寶奪回。期間，宇發現神秘女子金鷗也在追尋珠寶，兩人協議合作。後宇知悉彪設局要他與強互相殘殺，故他與鷗、強對付彪，而珠寶原屬鷗亡兄擁有，宇無奈讓鷗拿回。

崔琼珍遵從父母遺訓照顧弟妹，專注工作。其弟妹擔心珍嫁杏無期，介紹趙福根給珍認識。珍與根一見傾慕，共墮愛河。珍暗中助根發展事業，根得悉後忿而辭職，惟根不忍珍傷心，兩人和好。各人也覓得如花美眷，皆大歡喜。
周樸園與婢女侍萍發生不倫之戀，侍萍誕下兩子後被逐。長子周萍長大後，與婢女四鳳相戀，鳳珠胎暗結。誰料鳳是侍萍的女兒，侍萍不許兩人相見，兩人決定私奔。可是兩人得知身世後大受打擊，鳳觸電身亡，周萍吞槍自殺。
楊文浩、文芳兩兄妹之父親遭錢唯重騙財，農場亦被他據為己有。重長子少士不值其父所為，幫助浩與芳混進錢家，伺機奪回農場的地契。重垂涎芳的美色，與次子世計爭奪美人，芳遂向重施以美人計，最終成功取回地契。
賈寶玉周旋於林黛玉與薛寶釵之間，唯他對黛玉痴情。家人欲替寶玉完婚，眾人屬意寶釵，但怕寶玉反對，故騙寶玉讓他娶黛玉。大婚之日，黛玉誤會寶玉負情病倒，寶玉得知受騙趕見黛玉，惜黛玉病逝，寶玉悲痛，決意出家。
趙求胡扯賽馬貼士騙取金錢被識破，求妻對丈夫大感失望，留書出走。求的同事得悉求曾給的賽馬貼士全命中，向求下注，求挪用賭本開設食肆，豈料冷馬跑出，求走投無路而跳海。求妻往拜祭求，喜見求無恙，兩夫妻終和好。
周樸園與婢女侍萍發生不倫之戀，侍萍誕下兩子後被逐。長子周萍長大後，與婢女四鳳相戀，鳳珠胎暗結。誰料鳳是侍萍的女兒，侍萍不許兩人相見，兩人決定私奔。可是兩人得知身世後大受打擊，鳳觸電身亡，周萍吞槍自殺。

朱潤祥見工被騙金錢，於債主孔家的雲吞麵店工作，卻遭同事沙皮狗針對，幸獲店主女兒孔珍妮賞識。何伯壇於隔鄰開設上海麵店，祥亦被他挖角。狗與老千合謀向孔家騙財，幸祥及時阻止，並提議妮與壇合營麵店，和氣生財。
吳翩翩因父親被綁架，與表妹林素蘭回港，得悉周全和雷誠為了藏金圖捉走吳父，而戀人雷浩然竟是誠之子。全、誠發現翩、蘭身分，用計擒下二人，吳父被迫交出藏金圖。全、誠利用然將翩等人一網打盡，卻反被翩等人收拾。
狐妖化身宮娥媚香迷惑昭王，獲封西宮。金儀正宮肅整宮規，香為報被罰之仇，變身儀行刺王，使儀和鴻圖太子受懲罰。香欲燒死儀，幸儀得天后娘娘相救，又賜予斬狐劍及滅狐咒，終把香和讒臣滅。王自覺昏庸，決讓位予圖。

魏老爺拖欠工人薪金，陳凡助眾人討回薪酬，阿玉因而對他傾心。凡的好友遺失了金錢，幸得凡仗義借錢，故回贈一張馬票給凡，凡拒收，玉把馬票藏於凡的衣服內。魏得知凡中了馬票頭獎，施計奪馬票失敗，凡更將獎金捐出。

epg.programme_title_en: Queen Snake Comes to Life Again
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 李靖夫人黃氏遭百花蛇妖毒害，返魂乏術，蛇妖借屍還魂，以美色迷惑紂王，欲為妃嬪。李靖欲揭穿蛇妖身分，卻被紂王判處斬首。哪吒闖進王宮與蛇妖相鬥，後得太乙真人之助收拾蛇妖，李靖與黃氏亦得以獲救。
梁芬母親三姑將顧客的馬票據為己有，並幸運地中了頭獎。三姑嫌芬未婚夫張維窮，施計逼維離開芬。芬參加香車美人大賽前，得悉母親逼婚的計劃離去。三姑夫婦被騙子騙走家財後，回復窮困生活，而維與芬冰釋，和好如初。
關壽峰及女兒秀姑遇上軍閥刁難，幸樊家樹相助。樹資助沈鳳喜讀書，二人互生情愫，訂下婚約。劉大帥看上喜，喜遭污辱，樹計劃與喜逃亡，惜事敗，喜被虐打致失常。為救喜，秀姑色誘大帥；峰則潛入大帥府，刺殺了大帥。
阿利偶然發現大盜孟達的藏寶，取得財寶後被貪財的兄長連累，達追捕利。利與莫梨娜姊妹逃至王城向國王獻寶，得其重用。宰相與達合謀奪取王位及對付利，利中了宰相的奸計，幸宰相的手下良心發現救出利，利終撃退二人。
林綺梅被利用運毒而被捕，出獄後，得岑美瑩介紹，當何曼玲之私人看護，而玲夫李思豪竟是梅的舊情人。患病的玲喝下梅配製的藥後猝死，瑩要梅離開。豪與梅一起，瑩妒火中燒，誣陷梅殺死玲，幸終真相大白，梅沉冤得雪。

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Transformed from a young laboratory researcher, the thunderbolt-fisted Inframan must battle Princess Dragon Mom who wakes up from hibernation to conquer the earth with her army of mutant monsters.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: This is an epic tale set during the time of the Sino-Japanese war. A painter Yu saves a young girl, Lotus, who is being sold to a brothel. They fall in love, get married and settled in to a peaceful life. However, their life is soon shattered by the

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本片根據中國經典同名名著改編.故事講述唐僧赴西天取經,中途在五指山收服馬騮精;在高家莊收服豬八戒;在流沙河收服沙悟淨的種種情節..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adapted from the classic Chinese novel of the same title, the story follows Monk Tang San Zangs journey to the West in search of the Buddhist Sutra. On the way, he encounters and takes as disciples, Monkey, Pigsy and Sha Wu Jing.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: This masterpiece spins three interconnected tales about Hong Kong societys differing views on love and what women want from love. Follow a trio of Hong Kong women as they explore relationships and fulfil their hopes of finding true love.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: This is a sequel to Chang Chehs epic The Water Margin, and follows the patriotic story of seven warriors in the band of 108 outlaws at Mount Liang. The magnificent seven battle against the despotic government officials to save their country.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Moving to Thailand to work at an ice factory under a strict anti-violence vow, a young boy breaks his oath to confront a corrupt boss after his cousins disappear and he discovers the business is a front for drug smuggling.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: A re-imagining of L. Frank Baums classic The Wizard of Oz.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這部現代動作驚悚片圍繞著前中央情報局(CIA)探員尼克·蘭道(Nick Randall)展開.現為賞金獵人的他受僱追查一名殘暴的國際恐怖分子,以阻止其計畫在洛杉磯發動毀滅性的化學武器攻擊.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A modern action-thriller following Nick Randall, an ex-CIA operative turned bounty hunter who is hired to track down a ruthless international terrorist planning a devastating chemical attack on Los Angeles.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 傑瑞德・巴特勒與尼可拉・科斯特-瓦爾道主演,化身彼此對立的諸神,展開一場決定宇宙命運的史詩對決,震撼人心的奇幻冒險.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Gerard Butler and Nikolaj Coster-Waldau star as rival gods locked in an epic battle to decide the fate of the universe in this thrilling fantasy-adventure.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一部以馬雅文明為背景的冒險電影,講述年輕獵人「美洲豹爪」在被俘並押往獻祭之地後,為了生存並拯救家人而展開的驚險求生之旅.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A Mayan adventure film that follows the journey of a young hunter, Jaguar Paw, who must survive and rescue his family after being captured and taken to a sacrificial site.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在戰後的日本,哥吉拉的出現為滿目瘡痍的國土帶來了新的浩劫.當軍方無力介入、政府束手無策之際,倖存者們必須在絕望中團結起來,迎戰這股無情的恐怖力量.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In postwar Japan, Godzilla brings new devastation to an already scorched landscape. With no military intervention or government help in sight, the survivors must join together in the face of despair and fight back against an unrelenting horror.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 貪腐富豪殺害犯罪目擊者,唯一證人是一名與中國政府有關係的商人之女友.北京保鑣協助香港警方保護她,卻在過程中與證人產生情愫,令任務更加複雜.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Corrupt tycoon kills witness to a crime. Only the girlfriend of a businessman with Chinese govt. ties saw it. Beijing bodyguard helps Hong Kong police protect her. But he and the witness develop feelings, complicating matters.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一位男子意外發現自己擁有驚人的超能力,能瞬間移動到世界上任何他能想像到的地方,就此展開一段史詩般的冒險之旅.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The epic adventures of a man who discovers that he possesses the exhilarating ability to instantly teleport anywhere in the world he can imagine.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一位男子意外發現自己擁有驚人的超能力,能瞬間移動到世界上任何他能想像到的地方,就此展開一段史詩般的冒險之旅.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The epic adventures of a man who discovers that he possesses the exhilarating ability to instantly teleport anywhere in the world he can imagine.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在一場秘密任務失敗後,一名士兵幸運逃脫,卻不得不將摯友留在敵人手中.一年後,他冒著失去一切的風險,展開了一場扣人心弦的單槍匹馬救援行動!由湯瑪斯·伊恩·格里菲斯(Thomas Ian Griffith)主演,這是一部充滿爆發力與腎上腺素飆升的終極忠誠傳奇.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: When a covert mission goes wrong, a soldier escapes—leaving his best friend in enemy hands. A year later, he risks it all on a pulse-pounding rogue rescue! Thomas Ian Griffith stars in this explosive, adrenaline-fueled tale of ultimate loyalty.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 席維斯・史特龍主演《???》,飾演一名失意英雄,在紐約市隧道崩塌之際,與時間賽跑營救受困通勤族.爆炸性的動作與懸疑氣氛,成就這部高風險災難驚悚片.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Sylvester Stallone stars in Daylight as a fallen hero racing to rescue commuters trapped in a collapsing NYC tunnel. Explosive action and suspense power this high-stakes disaster thriller!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 當重裝雇傭兵圍攻白宮,一名面試特勤局失敗的特警必須衝破封鎖線,奮力營救總統、拯救被扣為人質的女兒,並阻止第三次世界大戰爆發.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: When heavily armed mercenaries siege the White House, a rejected Secret Service applicant must fight through the lockdown to save the President, rescue his hostage daughter, and prevent World War III.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一對感到厭倦的夫妻意外發現兩人竟是效力於競爭機構的頂尖殺手,而他們的下一個任務,就是除掉對方.這場婚姻諮商頓時火藥味十足.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A bored married couple discovers they are both elite assassins working for competing agencies—and their next assignment is to eliminate each other. Marriage counseling just got explosive.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一名年輕人移居泰國並在一家冰廠工作,原本立誓絕不使用暴力,但在堂兄弟相繼失蹤、且發現該工廠竟是毒品走私的掩護後,他打破誓言以挺身對抗貪腐的大老闆.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Moving to Thailand to work at an ice factory under a strict anti-violence vow, a young boy breaks his oath to confront a corrupt boss after his cousins disappear and he discovers the business is a front for drug smuggling.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這部現代動作驚悚片圍繞著前中央情報局(CIA)探員尼克·蘭道(Nick Randall)展開.現為賞金獵人的他受僱追查一名殘暴的國際恐怖分子,以阻止其計畫在洛杉磯發動毀滅性的化學武器攻擊.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A modern action-thriller following Nick Randall, an ex-CIA operative turned bounty hunter who is hired to track down a ruthless international terrorist planning a devastating chemical attack on Los Angeles.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一對疏遠的兄弟——一個是成績優異的高材生,另一個則是曾進過感化院的叛逆青年——在加入同一所高中的田徑隊後,不僅得在賽場上激烈競爭,更面臨著情感上的沉重考驗.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Two estranged brothers—a straight-A student and a former reform school youth—face intense athletic rivalry and emotional strain when they compete on the same high school track team.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 決定宇宙存亡的終極對決爆發!最後的槍客羅蘭跨越異次元,誓死抵禦黑衣人的邪惡侵襲.一旦黑暗塔倒塌,全宇宙將徹底陷入萬劫不復的深淵!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The ultimate battle for existence begins! Armed with deadly aim, Roland the Last Gunslinger crosses realities to defend the mythical Dark Tower from the sinister Man in Black. If the tower falls, the universe crumbles into absolute darkness!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 當妻子在結婚紀念日當天神秘失蹤,丈夫成了頭號嫌疑人.隨著媒體鋪天蓋地的瘋狂報導,各種毒辣的秘密陸續曝光, reveal 他們完美的婚姻不過是一場致命的錯覺.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: When his wife mysteriously vanishes on their anniversary, a man becomes the prime suspect. As the media circus explodes, toxic secrets reveal their perfect marriage is a deadly illusion.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: After the parents of Ruby (Leelee Sobieski) and her younger brother, Rhett (Trevor Morgan), are killed in a car crash, their parents' best friends, Erin and Terry Glass (Diane Lane, Stellan Skarsgard), become their guardians. The children hear promises of a world of opulence and California fun -- all they have to do is move into the Glasses' gated house. Before very long, though, Ruby suspects that Erin and Terry may not be the ideal guardians they seemed to be.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 王小俠本是一個胸無大志,在市井街頭討生活的小鎮青年,與父親老瞎子生活在十隱鎮,唯一的願望就是能治好父親的眼疾。一次偶然令王小俠邂逅了沈藍兒,並意外地捲入了一場陰謀之中。而王小俠為了找能治好父親的眼疾方..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A young man Wang Xiao Xia resides in a small town with his blind father. His only desire is to cure his fathers eye disease. One day, he encounters Shen Nan Er by chance and gets embroiled in a conspiracy. In his quest to heal his fathers eyes, he goes to the Qi Yin Sect and finally unveils his hidden identity, which was concealed by his father.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 童松因為一場車禍失去雙腿,不過他擁有著超高智商,並與擅長電腦科技的安寧及身手不凡的大牛合夥開辦保鏢公司。公司接到的第一單是保護寵物狗的任務,看似平常,但在委托的過程中實則危機四伏,麻煩不斷,更發現背後..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Tong Song is a genius but unfortunately lost his limbs in a car accident. He sets up a security services company with a computer expert and a skilful fighter, and their first job is to protect a dog. The job seems quite simple, but it turns out to be a perilous task as they unravel a conspiracy behind the mission.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 剛建成的洛陽宮夜裡被一條神龍縱火焚燒,木匠不是死就是失蹤。狄仁傑破格升任大理寺少卿查案,卻遭神秘勢力阻撓。他憑線索及隱士李先生的指點找到了關鍵人物宮少爺,也在紅顏知己柳月如協助下摧毀了機關基地。關鍵時..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The newly completed Luo Yang Palace is set to fire by the Fire Dragon, resulting in the carpenters being missing or dead. Detective Dee is tasked to investigate the case. He finds the cases key person, demolishes a secret base with his best friend Liu, and kills the Fire Dragon, vowing to uncover the truth.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 南宋末年,國家陷入內憂外患的局面。狄族聯合魔教,妄想踏平中原稱霸江湖,危難之際,無極派大弟子張君寶又名張三豐挺身而出,協助朝廷擊退敵軍,卻不料師門慘遭魔教血洗,死傷慘重。為了振興門派,保衛家園,張毅然..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Tribe Di join forces with the Demon Cult to rule the martial arts world. Zhang San Feng, a disciple of Wu Ji Clan, helps the government to fight the rebels but this results in his clan suffering heavy casualties. To save his clan and his homeland, Zhang sets out to destroy the Demon Cult but gets entangled in another conspiracy in the process.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 1996年之前的香港,雪麗在自己的婚禮現場遭遇劫匪挾持,並目睹丈夫死於匪徒槍下。雪現於一家射箭館任職,在颱風之夜意外滯留大樓內,並目擊當年同一幫匪徒在大廈內殺人。在逃亡過程中,她遇到了同為滯留者的盲眼..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: During her wedding in 1996, Xue Li is taken hostage by gangsters and saw her husband being killed. One night in a typhoon, Xue Li is forced to stay at her workplace in a building, where she witnesses another murder by the same group of gangsters. As she tries to escape, she meets a blind old man and they must fight for survival together.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 武狀元蘇燦在打擊販賣大煙的天門教鬥爭中意外受傷失憶,流落街頭淪為蘇乞兒,及後被金枝和小果母女收留。小果意外發現了配製好的鴉片膏,被天門教捉走。蘇乞兒為了救小果及避免鴉片禍害百姓,一舉破壞了天門教的..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Top martial artist Su Can lost his memory in a battle with the opium seller, Tian Men Cult. He becomes a beggar and is taken in by a mother and her daughter. The daughter is caught by the cult when she accidentally discovers the opium. Beggar Su joins the court to save the girl and destroy the cult, so as to stop the opiums harm on people.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 江城傳奇神槍手“鬼手,被保護江城安寧的羲和堂以叛徒之名追捕。小混混陸瀾意外得知哥哥被鬼手所殺,為了復仇加入羲和堂,在女殺手冷楓的培養下成長為一名頂尖槍手。陸決意殺掉鬼手為兄報仇,在生死槍戰之際卻發現..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Jiang Cheng, the secretive Xi He Hall controls the city’s underworld while hunting its legendary former sniper, “Ghost Hand”, branded a traitor. When street hustler Lu Lan impersonates the infamous marksman to make a living, he is captured by the organisation’s deadliest assassin and drawn into a deadly conspiracy.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在罪惡橫行的世界裡,有一個叫太平鎮的桃花源。這裡有私人英雄守護而未被黑幫入侵。吳正義為了成為私人英雄的一員,每天苦練功夫,在正義救星中心雄先生的幫助下成為私人英雄。隨後他發現該鎮被邪惡集團控制,最終與..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In a crime-ridden world, there remains a town safeguarded by the private heroes from the triads. Wu Zheng Yi practises kung fu everyday and finally becomes a private hero with the help from Xiong. When Wu discovers that the private heroes are controlled by the evil gang, he teams up with his master Xiong to vanquish the evil gang boss.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 故事販賣機由四個獨立單元組成,包括《馴兔記》馴服小孩變成兔子的童話故事;《鬼打牆》男子來到酒店約會,卻誤入鬼打牆走不出去的懸疑故事;《官能許願》超能力男孩,以器官為代價,拯救意外慘死女友的愛情故事;及..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The movie consists of four short stories: a fairy tale about a kid turning into a rabbit, a suspense story about a man trapped in a haunted wall during a date, a love story about a lad with supernatural power sacrificing his organ for his lover, and a fantasy tale about magical pleasures after eating the chicken soup noodles sold in the city.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 歡宜寨突然怪病橫行,為了救寨,守山人長生前去尋找傳說中的九色鹿王。另外,大月國王宮內已被妖後控制,太子延頤為了阻止妖後,也踏上尋找九色鹿王的道路。長和延二人在途中要不斷躲避妖後的追殺,幸好有小藜等人幫..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Huan Yi Village is hit by a strange disease while the Demon Queen controls the Palace, so Chang and Prince Yan are forced to seek out the legendary Nine-colour Deer King to save the people and stop the Demon Queen. Evading the Queens pursuit, they uncover the Deer Kings secret with their allies, restoring peace to the village and the kingdom.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 金傲為保護中華傲決與無敵大戰,在生命垂危的時候將中華傲決傳授給華英雄。然而擁有“天煞孤星命格的華英雄失去了父母及妻子,離開了兒女,潛心修煉二十年卻始終無法參悟中華傲決。最終,華為了所有中國人要與無敵..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jin Ao battles with Wu Di to preserve the Pride martial arts skill, which he passes to Hero Hua before he dies. Hua, who is born under the curse of the Star of Loneliness, leaves his family to practise the martial arts skill for 20 years, but still fails to master it. Can Hua finally master the skill and defeats Wu Di to save his people?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 江南才子唐伯虎在宴會中為心儀女子桃寶一擲千金,卻被神秘男子出重金羞辱。唐氣憤出手打人,不料那人正是皇上,因此他被通緝。為了躲避追捕,唐偽裝成太監潛入宮中,卻陰差陽錯被卷入閩南王馮達的造反事件。唐得知造..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Tang Bo Hu spends lavishly on a woman but is outbid by a mysterious man. Angered, Tang punches the man, who is actually the Emperor. He sneaks into the palace to evade arrest, but gets entangled in a revolt led by King Feng. As Tang discovers that the evidence of Fengs rebellion is hidden in a painting, he vows to uncover the plot.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 少年閻晃跟著身為撈屍人的師父老姜,在天水村遇到離奇事件,傳聞二十年前有水怪禍亂屠戮村莊,現在怨靈回魂伺機索命,流言四起。在調查期間,閻在林瑤及老姜等人的幫助下堅定立場,不被封建迷信所蒙蔽,努力探尋真相..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Rumour has it that a water monster destroyed the village 20 years ago, and now its vengeful spirit has returned. As Yan and his master encounter mysterious incidents in the village, Yan decides to find out the truth without being influenced by superstitions. In the process, Yan discovers his true identity and captures the real culprit.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 民國女學生林家英親眼目睹姐姐被軍閥馬世傑迫害致死而卻無能為力,並在隨後趕到的何美梓口中得知姐姐原來是秘密特工隊“魅影的一員。為替姐姐報仇,英加入魅影特工隊,接受訓練成為一名美豔特工。在一次執行任務中..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Young student Ying helplessly witness her sister being persecuted to death by a warlord. When she realizes her sister is a member of the secret agency Phantom, Ying vows to avenge her death and joins Phantom. She eventually becomes a pretty secret agent but soon unveils the secret behind Phantom during a mission.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一心想要去學習嶗山道法的少年王生,終獲高人指點,學成歸家,之後卻把師父“不可生邪念的教誨丟在腦後,學了點法術便打算用來行竊。隅然王解開了自己身世之謎,又經過幾番歷練才終於開悟,決定用屬於自己的方式來..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Young Wang Sheng aspires to learn Laoshan Taoism skills. Under the tutelage of his master, Wang acquires the skills but succumbs to greed, forsaking the masters teachings of Think No Evil. As Wang finds out about his own identity, his epiphany sparks enlightenment, prompting him to forge his unique path in vanquishing the demons.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 唐門有一秘寶“洞天儀,可以提前預知惡人名錄。唐門會在此人作惡之前將其殺掉來維護天下太平。一天,唐門掌門唐無煙之名竟也出現於洞天儀之上,無煙被迫逃走,遇到善良小賊楚晨。在其幫助下,她決心殺回唐門尋找真..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Within the Tang Sect lies a treasure that will unveil names of future villains, who the Sect will kill before they can commit their evil acts. When Sect leader Yans name surfaces, she is forced to flee but meets a compassionate thief, Chu. Together they return to the Tang Sect and uncover the truth behind the conspiracy to prove her innocence.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 雷霆安保公司的幽靈小隊,由林森帶領隊友執行解救女科學家南茜的任務。眾人救南後在撤離時見到一名小孩被關在籠裡,趕去營救,卻聽到槍響,之後全軍覆沒。於偉剛寫下小說“幽靈狙擊的一段,跟著一聲槍響,被擊中頭..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Lin Shen leads the insurance company’s ghost team to save a scientist. During the mission, they discover a child trapped in a cage but are ambushed on their way to the rescue. As Yu Wei writes the final paragraph of his novel “Ghost Sniper”, he is shot in the head. It is not until he wakes up that Yu Wei realises he has become his novel’s character!

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Forensic pathologist Qing investigates her brothers murder by the water monkeys in a town where the curse of a vengeful monkey ensues. Armed with a gun, Qing ventures to the forbidden land of Water Monster and debunks superstitions with scientific facts, ultimately leading the villagers to fight against the evil forces.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 清乾隆年間,紅花會老舵主于萬亭病逝,命其義子陳家洛受命接任掌門之位。之後紅花會多個分舵遭受襲擊,而四當家文泰來下落不明。陳與消息靈通的玉如意達成交易,兩人與幾位當家合作營救文。其後陳發現文的失蹤可能是..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the Qing dynasty, Chen Jia Luo is appointed as the new leader of Red Flower Society. Thereafter, the societys members face attacks and one of their branch leaders, Wen, goes missing. As Chen teams up with Yu to rescue Wen, he uncovers a connection between Wen’s disappearance and King Fus treasure. Meanwhile, Yus real identity also surfaces.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 退休運動員肖力在父親的激勵下,帶領村中的女童足球隊贏得了比賽,並且幫助學校擺脫了困境。這勵志的故事展現了人們為了美好生活奮鬥,在過程中增進及修補了家人、戀人、師生等人與人之間的相互關係,並表達了美好生..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Motivated by his father, a retired athlete helps the female soccer team to win the game and ease the plight of the school. This inspirational story showcases the effort by people to achieve a better life while working hard at relationships with family members, lovers, teachers and students.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在無人區的荒野裡正發生著一場驚險的生死追蹤。少年堇言意外拍下了盜獵者襲擊警方的場面,不幸被歹徒發現後擊傷了堇。他忍耐著疼痛一路逃走,其後這幫人還挾持堇的姐姐樸雨。兩姐弟在無人區裡奮力逃走,憑藉著堅強意..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A fatal pursuit happens in a no mans land. Young Jin Yan accidentally captures the scene of a poacher attacking a cop, and the villains attack and injure him when they discover his act. As Jin tries to escape, they kidnap his sister as well. Jin and his sister must strive to escape from the villains and bring them to justice.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 唐時期垂拱元年,武則天率領百官坐龍船夜巡運河,各人奔向龍門只為一睹天后聖容,沒想到卻在運河之中遭遇龍形異獸衝撞龍船,引起了百姓的議論,認為是不祥之兆。武則天對此事件勃然大怒,召見狄仁傑前去調查運河龍王..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Empress Wu and her officials patrol the Grand Canal one night. As the crowd rushes to see her in person, a dragon monster appears and hits on the vessel. This is believed to be an ominous sign. Empress Wu is angry and asks Detective Di to investigate the case. Detective Di uses his investigative mind to unravel the truth and find the culprit.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 明朝崇禎末年,正派與魔教勢不兩立互有爭鬥。白髮魔女練霓裳因此陷入一場江湖的腥風血雨當中,內裡更蘊含著重大陰謀。錦衣衛常安奉命暗中調查白髮魔女練霓裳,在追查的道路上,常安對練霓裳產生了莫名的情愫,要為練..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In late Ming dynasty, conflicts arise between the Justice Cult and the Demon Cult. The White Haired Witch is entangled in a conspiracy amidst the battle of the martial arts world. As Imperial guard Chang An investigates on her, he falls for the White Haired Witch. Finally, Chang An uncovers the true leader of the Demon Cult, thus clearing her name.

epg.programme_title_tc: 大法醫宋慈系列之偷梁換柱
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 宋慈在建甯縣遇到知縣大人誤判吳蜚卿案,為了幫助吳洗脫冤屈找出真相,宋必須在兩天之內抓住真凶。根據紙扇上的神秘痕跡、消失不見的兇器、宋在面對種種疑點,終於找出了與兇手有關的蛛絲馬跡。此時,突然出現的一份..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Tasked with absolving Wus wrongful conviction, Song Ci races against time to unveil the real culprit within two days. With the enigmatic clues on a paper fan and a missing weapon, Song Ci draws closer to finding the culprit. However, an indictment hiding a conspiracy suddenly appears, leaving Song Ci speechless...

epg.programme_title_tc: 伏妖開封府之御貓展昭
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 北宋時期,宦官專權,邪靈橫行,汴梁境內興起了許多邪教,其中最大勢力是“外九流。開封府裡的包拯、展昭和公孫策秘密審理邪靈案,然而“外九流的人試圖毒害包拯,還籌劃著更龐大的陰謀。面對此情況,開封府眾人..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Eunuchs are powerful in the Northern Song Dynasty as evil religion sects emerge, with the largest one being “Wai Jiu Liu”. As Justice Bao, Zhan Zhao and Gong Sun Ce secretly preside over the trials involving evil spirits, the disciples of “Wai Jiu Liu” try to poison Bao and hedge a huge plot. How can Justice Bao tackle the plight?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 二十年前,一顆外太空隕石載著三顆晶瑩玉石墜落人間一村莊,傳聞任何人進入此村莊的森林都會遇到山鬼,而從沒人能成功走出來。二十年後傳說中的山鬼又再次出現,而且引發了多宗血案。當案件被深入調查時,原本被掩蓋..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Two decades ago, a meteorite carrying three crystals struck a village on Earth. Rumor has it that anyone entering the village forest will be haunted by a mountain ghost and trapped. After 20 years, the ghost reappears, causing a series of murders. As investigation begins, the hidden truth behind the mystery is gradually uncovered.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 民國年間,發丘一脈的傳人張聞風為了尋找父親失蹤真相,及阻止境外惡勢力盜取不死神樹,與夥伴踏上兇險萬分的古墓之旅,但他們卻誤闖誤撞進入了崑崙山,一個藏有 百神 的上古神跡崑崙墟。然而令張意想不到的是..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Zheng Min Feng embarks on a thrilling journey with his friend to an ancient tomb to find his missing father and protect the immortal tree. However, they mistakenly go to Mount Kwun Lun, the sacred site with One Hundred Gods. Amidst the creepy legend and perilous journey, they must confront the enigmatic depths of the human heart.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一個佛與魔較量的故事。為阻止上古妖魔羅剎降世,將世間顛覆成萬劫不復的寒冰煉獄,少林寺弟子慧海踏上了尋找降龍羅漢之旅。青梅竹馬的上官靈素始終陪伴守護慧海,不畏困難,幫助慧海破除心魔,參透少林精神,最終憑..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In a battle between Buddha and Devil, Shaolin disciple Hui Hai embarks on a journey to find Luo Han to stop the demon from turning the world upside down. Accompanied by his childhood friend, Hui is fearless and masters the Shaolin spirit. Eventually with the Shaolin skills, they banish all demons and restore peace to the world.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 海上救難隊員阿傑為了生計及克服之前同伴遇難的陰影,再次乘坐漁船出海謀生,卻再次遭遇巨大的危機。在船上的人不僅要面對惡劣的暴雨天氣,還有海底未知生物正對著他們虎視眈眈。在茫茫大海中,猙獰相對的眾人更必須..

The fleet encounters severe rainstorm and has to face an unknown sea creature. In the face of adversity, everyone on board must overcome the challenges to trust and support each other in order to escape from danger.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 民國年間,陰陽鎮遭恐怖詛咒,傳說進去後誰也出不去,離開的人都會神秘死亡。尋寶人閻陽一和寶葫蘆誤入了陰陽鎮,雖然閻不相信傳說,但他在鎮上卻常常遇到可怕的事情。然而讓閻和寶更沒想到的是,在詛咒之下的詭異小..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Yin Yang Town has been cursed during the Republican period and legend has it that anyone who leaves the town will be mysteriously killed. Two treasure hunters who do not believe the legend inadvertently enter the town and experience horrifying events. The real surprise lies in an astonishing secret in this cursed town...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 民國時期,北海市發生連續殺人案,幻術師羅賓協助警員龍聰調查。兩人發現死者大多是隱姓埋名的幻術師,羅賓推測兇手殺人的目的是為了寶藏,卻發現真兇美智子利用暗黑幻術殺人。最後美智子用幻術召喚出玄冰白虎,而羅..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Illusionist Robin assists a police officer to investigate a serial murder. While they discover that most victims are incognito illusionists, Robin thinks that the murderer kills for a treasure, and later identifies Mei as the culprit who uses dark illusions to kill. Mei summons White Tiger to fight against the Fire Dragon commanded by Robin.

epg.programme_title_tc: 聊齋古卷: 蘭若之境
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 蒲松齡在寫故事時無意打開了生老病三道門的封印,放出了巨樹之妖黑山的分身。天女發現黑山,與其大打出手,不幸身形被滅,要借助蒲的妻子甄娘化為人形。打鬥中她們被黑山所困,天女告知蒲若要救出甄娘,他得要感動三..

She borrows the body of Pus wife to continue the fight but they get trapped by the Black Mountain Demon. To save his wife, Pu must touch another three demons heart.

As Lu investigates, he finds a dance girl and her brother suspicious, and the brother suddenly goes missing. Lu, Da and the dance girl find themselves involved in a conspiracy and after much investigation, Lu finds the culprit and unravels the secret of a hidden treasure.

As Lu investigates, he finds a dance girl and her brother suspicious, and the brother suddenly goes missing. Lu, Da and the dance girl find themselves involved in a conspiracy and after much investigation, Lu finds the culprit and unravels the secret of a hidden treasure.

Fueled by anger, the shark turns to attack four friends who are celebrating their graduation on a yacht. A life-and-death struggle between the four friends and the big white shark has just begun!

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Scholar Wang Sheng fortuitously rescues the fox demon Xiang Er and brings her home. Unaware of her identity, he falls in love with her, hoping for her to become his concubine. However, Xiang Er is manipulated by the old demoness to do evil and harm people. Will their paranormal love triumph over darkness, allowing them to live happily ever after?

epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the Southern Song era, a young master and staff at Fei Yun inn aid General Li Xian Zhong to recover the lost territory in a northern expedition. However, Deputy General Shaos jealousy and sabotage cause the mission to fail. Fueled by anger, the team vows to capture Shao while helping the civilians to evacuate.

It is when Ge Zhen investigates a case that he encounters Qiu Kui and they fall in love. At the same time, Wu Ma, the most powerful killer in the squad is mysteriously murdered. Can Ge Zhen and Qiu Kui be together, and can Ge Zhen rescue his country?

Warlord Xiao Ba Tin colludes with some bandits and force the poor to plant opium. Ah Xi steps up to fight against them and finally exterminate the evil gang.

However, He claims that she is innocent while Bai Li is the one who has betrayed the patriots. Things become suspicious and Lui is unsure of whom to trust. Who will he trust in the end?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 張宸是軍事戰術教官,經常輾轉於世界各地為安保公司做戰術培訓。一次意外中,張被捲入一宗謀殺案,成了當地的通緝犯。張被迫逃亡,並在同伴初五的幫助下找到了謀殺案倖存者黛米。三人相互配合,開始著手調查,在槍林..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Military instructor Zhang Zhen accidentally gets involved in a murder and becomes the suspect. He is forced to flee and with the help of his companion, Zhang finds the sole survivor of the murder. The trio launches an investigation and strives to uncover the truth, which seems to be connected to a human smuggling gang and a military organization.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 大陳天啟年間,發生了西域舞姬控物懸浮事件,負責靈異怪事的部門“夜行司派出陳淩前往無相城調查。城內叛徒木道人假意幫陳,其實想奪走城內的異能植物日輪花,讓大陳百姓感染花毒癲狂噬人,以報服大陳和無相城..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the Chen Dynasty, Chen Ling is assigned to investigate a supernatural case in Wu Xiang City. There, a man who pretends to help Chen Ling wants to steal a supernatural plant whose poison will cause people to bite each other, so as to take revenge on Chen and the master who killed his tribe. A fierce battle has just begun!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 民國員警王之章的兒子因鴉片而亡。他痛恨舊社會犯罪橫行,封建思想荼毒百姓,因此偽裝成道士潛入當地商人陳老爺家調查鴉片走私案件,期間卻遇到連環殺人事件。身為員警的王之章為了職責及為兒子報仇,誓要抓住兇手,..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Policeman Wang hates crime in the city and the feudalism that lead to his sons death by opium. Disguised as a Taoist priest, he investigates opium smuggling in a merchants home and uncovers a series of murders. Driven by duty and revenge, Wang vows to find the murderer, destroy the stored opium and restore peace in the city.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 天后武則天壽宴之際,房州城發生“赤目怪物傷人事件。狄仁傑奉命與不良人沈青青及徒弟陳江橋結成探案分隊前往調查,而所有證據似乎都表明幕後主謀正是被廢太子李顯,但狄卻敏銳地發現真相絕非如此簡單,背後蘊藏著..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Red-Eye Monster attacks Fang Zhou City on Empress Wus birthday. Detective Dee is assigned to investigate the case. While all clues apparently point to the deposed prince, Detective Dee realizes that there is a conspiracy behind. Together with another investigation team, Detective Dee finally unravels the truth of the mystery.

These encounters make Master Li question who is more evil, humans or demons?

Detective Di is assigned to investigate the case, and not only did he manage to unravel the mystery, he also uncovers the truth and finds the culprit.

Upon investigation, Guo discovers a man named Xia Chong disguising himself as the female ghost, leading to the revelation of a peculiar murder case.

Gou tries to bring his friends out from the hotel but this results in a fierce battle with those being infected. As conflicts and suspicions arise during the escape, can they finally reconcile and flee successfully?

Fourteen years later, Liu chances upon Huos martial arts school and meets Blood Demon who returns for vengeance against Huos clan. Liu fights Blood Demon with Huos legendary skills, upholding justice and protecting Huos clan in a deadly battle.

He remains resilient and insists on keeping all his staffs, hoping for a turnaround. When gangsters hold his staffs, customers and fiancée hostage in the restaurant one day, he vows to fight back and bring them to justice.

When a convoy escorts the treasure map to help the former prince regain his position, Emperor Qi assigns Kun Lun Cult master to eliminate the rebels and seize the map, causing great danger to the convoy and martial artists along the way.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: A group of university students embarks on a graduation trip, but accidentally trespass into an forbidden island, which is the home of a giant monster. Due to humans fault, the island is now a monster paradise. The students must defeat the monster to escape and as they explore further, they uncover a hidden conspiracy behind the trip.

When Wen Ning discovers anomalies in this situation, he joins forces with Nan Si Zhui to find the real culprit behind and finally restore peace and harmony to the city.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: 20 years ago, God of War Zhang Chi Yan sacrificed himself to restore the power of his sword so as to defeat the Tribe of Darkness. As the tribe becomes active again, Zhangs son, Ke, and his friends set out to restore the swords power. Zhang Ke is now the new God of War with the sword, leading his people to fight a deadly battle with the demons.

A restauranteur leads her staff to fight against the triads and protect the weak. They team up with the residents to combat the triads and fight against the corrupted police, finally restoring peace and harmony.

He falls from a cliff in a fight and accidentally enters the Chu State. As Chen Nan gradually restores his strength and memory,  he embarks on a journey to protect the world against evil.

When two imperial constables investigate the case, they discover that a Happiness drug is commonly abused in town. Despite facing many difficulties during the investigation, they strive to bring the mastermind to justice.

Despite an anarchist attack, the team strives to overcome the fierce battle so that the supplies can be delivered to the villagers successfully.

As he fights to rescue the captives, he becomes a target of revenge, even endangering his friends. Recognizing his limits, Ip Man works with the patriots to expose the gang’s thrilling conspiracy.

Not only do they have to face various crisis and attacks from beasts, they also have to uncover the truth behind it all so as to escape from danger.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 清朝末期,西方列強在中國橫行霸道,百姓民不聊生。此時民間天降“神諭,傳言大清要亡,加上顧命大臣接連暴斃,讓傳言更加沸騰。皇上任命九門提督富察·禦恒徹查此案,富察也請來好友蘇燦幫忙。燦發現刺客應該是用..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the late Qing dynasty, people are suffering from destitution. A divine omen and death of some ministers have sparked rumours of Qings downfall. Fu Cha is tasked by the Emperor to investigate, so he enlists the help of Su Can, who uncovers a brutal assassination plot involving illusions and unravels the secret behind the case.

epg.programme_title_tc: 津沽奇譚1: 暗城殺機
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 民國時期,津沽城命案接連發生,警局束手無策。一向以風水破案的段宇豪和祁威被要求調查此案以戴罪立功,免除之前的懲罰,但在找線索的同時,二人卻被一步步地推向多年前發生的羅剎鳥連環殺人案。段宇豪與祁..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In crime-ridden Jin Gu City, the police are unable to solve the murder cases. Duan Yu Hao and Qi Wei are assigned to investigate the cases through fortune-telling. In the process, a murder case that happened years ago is brought to their attention, and they vow to uncover the truth and find the murderer.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 民國初年的龍雲鎮,相傳鎮子發現寶藏後逐漸怪事不斷,接連出現少女家中被殺。同時,寶藏消息也招來各路心懷不軌的“江湖術士紛紛前來尋寶。巡捕隊的林隊長迫於鎮長壓力,決定聯手死刑犯計連營一起找出真凶及解開背..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A series of mysterious incidents happen when treasure is discovered in Long Yun Town, including killings of girls. As ill-intentioned martial artists arrive to uncover the treasure, Cop Lin, assigned by the mayor, teams up with a death row inmate to identify the murderer and uncover the truth, so as to safeguard the town and its people.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 濟公即將在突破最後一層成為降龍羅漢的關鍵時刻,感應到白水鎮村民有難,於是他放棄修行前往白水鎮解救百姓。在這裡他遇到了假扮濟公的黃元蠱惑百姓,差點把濟公燒死,但最終黃元被濟公所感化,並幫助濟公一起降魔伏..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ji Gong is about to transform into the Arhat when he foresees a threat to the villagers in town and decides to sacrifice his practice to rescue them. He encounters Huang, who impersonates him and bewitches the villagers, leading Ji Gong to be nearly burnt alive. When Huang is finally enlightened by Ji Gong, he joins him to subdue the demons.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 孫悟空被壓五指山下四百年時,碰巧被阿一所救。而龍太子得知悟空已逃出,要報當年東海龍宮被毀之仇,便利用悟空昔日好友蛟魔王刺殺悟空,但刺殺失敗,不過阿一被俘虜。為了救阿一,悟空與龍太子從海里打到南天門。最..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Trapped under Mount Wuzhi for 400 years, the Monkey King is saved by Ah Yi, but is targeted to be assassinated under the Prince Dragons orders. Though the mission fails, Ah Yi is captured and Monkey King battles the Prince Dragon across land and sea to rescue her. He finally redeems himself and returns to Mount Wuzhi to continue his training.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 雙腿殘疾的童松是矛盾安保公司的創始人,團隊中還有擅長機械的安寧和身手了得的大牛,公司主要是保護客戶安全,俗稱“保鏢。這天,他們接到一個匿名委託,要保護的人正是安寧的妹妹安逸,之後逸便頻生意外。童發現..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Handicapped Tong is the founder of a security company. His team includes mechanical expert An Ning and martial arts expert Da Niu. One day, they receive an anonymous order to protect An Nings sister, who since then has frequent accidents. While Tong unveils an organization specializing in accidental homicide, who wants to kill An Nings sister?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 民國初年,水派幻術師裴靜之為搶奪法寶大開殺戒,最終被火派幻術師空空封印,之後空空帶著一孤兒卓非凡離開。二十年後,裴解開封印想再次奪寶,將空空殺害。空空死前將自己撫養的卓託付給落霞飛學習火術。卓發誓要為..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Illusionist Pei of the Water Cult is trapped by Kong in a seal as he tries to kill to find the treasure. Kong leaves with an orphan Fang and 20 years later, Pei unseals himself to find the treasure again and kills Kong. As Fang learns the Fire skills from his master Kong, he vows to avenge his death but then discovers his ties to the Water Cult.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 趙子龍在常山歸隱七年後,因戰亂變故流落到鄴城與劉備及趙雲重逢。趙子龍終究被劉備的仁義所折服,在劉備與眾人的鼓勵及殘酷現實的鞭策之下,逐漸找回自我與理想,再次號召眾兄弟並肩作戰,最終在長阪坡大敗敵軍,成..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After hiding in Mount Zhang for seven years,  Zhao Zi Long reunites with Liu Bei and Zhao Yun. Persuaded by Lius righteousness, Zhao rediscovers his aspirations and rallies his comrades to battle their enemies at Chang Ban Slope. He eventually defeats the enemies and emerges as the Great General of the Han Dynasty.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 二十年後的未來世界,一群食客打算去一家違法經營的野味飯店享受一頓野味大餐,突然當中有一隻變種巨蜥衝破了鐵籠逃走,之後店員一個接一個地神秘失蹤。在此同時捕鼠專家阿發接到飯店的滅鼠委託,本來的滅鼠行動卻變..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In 2040s, a group of customers visits an illegal restaurant serving wild animal meat. Suddenly, a giant lizard mutant escapes from the cage and the restaurant staff disappears one by one. Meanwhile, a rat catcher is tasked by the restaurant to exterminate rats, but it turns out to be a terrifying battle against the lizard.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 蘇家布行二房長子蘇文興,渴望繼承家業,卻在與堂妹蘇檀兒的較量中被擊敗。興偶然得知他在眾人眼中只是一個吉祥物,為了證明自己的能力,興決心往外闖一番事業,但卻遭受連連挫折。正當他絕望之際,一位舊日同窗高甜..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Su Wen Xing aspires to take over the familys textile shop, but loses the control to his cousin. To prove himself, he sets out on a journey to find his own success but faces repeated setbacks. In despair, he reconnects with an old classmate who collaborates with him on a business venture, resulting in a series of amusing and chaotic escapades.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 江南才子唐伯虎在宴會中為心儀女子桃寶一擲千金,卻被神秘男子出重金羞辱。唐氣憤出手打人,不料那人正是皇上,因此他被通緝。為了躲避追捕,唐偽裝成太監潛入宮中,卻陰差陽錯被卷入閩南王馮達的造反事件。唐得知造..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Tang Bo Hu spends lavishly on a woman but is outbid by a mysterious man. Angered, Tang punches the man, who is actually the Emperor. He sneaks into the palace to evade arrest, but gets entangled in a revolt led by King Feng. As Tang discovers that the evidence of Fengs rebellion is hidden in a painting, he vows to uncover the plot.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 江南才子唐伯虎在宴會中為心儀女子桃寶一擲千金,卻被神秘男子出重金羞辱。唐氣憤出手打人,不料那人正是皇上,因此他被通緝。為了躲避追捕,唐偽裝成太監潛入宮中,卻陰差陽錯被卷入閩南王馮達的造反事件。唐得知造..

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Drug lords Kun and Hao prosper amidst a corrupt landscape in the 1970s Hong Kong. ICAC officer Rose embarks on a mission to infiltrate Haos gang to gather evidence. However, as Rose and Hao fall in love, she faces a heart-wrenching dilemma — choosing between her duty to bring him down and the irresistible pull of their intensifying romance.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 北魏年間,新君登基,時局未穩,遊牧民族柔然對魏國虎視眈眈。為牽制柔然,大魏公主和親北涼,不料卻被柔然猛將綿爾圖擄走。綿挾持公主,要魏國在兩日內交出十座城池為贖金。魏國將軍花木蘭臨危受命,更啟用死囚慕容..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Northern Wei empire faces raids from the nomadic Rou Ran tribe. The princess of Wei is kidnapped by a Rou Ran general, who demands ten cities as ransom. Weis General Mulan forms a special task force to rescue the princess and a fatal battle has just begun!

epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the battle between human and demons, human race leader, Huang Di, restores peace by magical astronomy and establishes the Wu Yin Sect. During an  escape, Detective Zhou encounters the dying Wu Yin Sect boss, who passes on his martial arts skills to Zhou. With the help of the sect, Zhou finds his inner power to defeat the demons.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Illusionist Robin assists a police officer to investigate a serial murder. While they discover that most victims are incognito illusionists, Robin thinks that the murderer kills for a treasure, and later identifies Mei as the culprit who uses dark illusions to kill. Mei summons White Tiger to fight against the Fire Dragon commanded by Robin.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 雷霆安保公司的幽靈小隊,由林森帶領隊友執行解救女科學家南茜的任務。眾人救南後在撤離時見到一名小孩被關在籠裡,趕去營救,卻聽到槍響,之後全軍覆沒。於偉剛寫下小說“幽靈狙擊的一段,跟著一聲槍響,被擊中頭..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Lin Shen leads the insurance company’s ghost team to save a scientist. During the mission, they discover a child trapped in a cage but are ambushed on their way to the rescue. As Yu Wei writes the final paragraph of his novel “Ghost Sniper”, he is shot in the head. It is not until he wakes up that Yu Wei realises he has become his novel’s character!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 為了取長補短,陳真遠赴日本學習工業技術。留學期間,陳真與擅長形意拳的武術家薛自立一起,為了捍衛中國人民的尊嚴,他們勇敢面對日本軍部官員的比武挑戰。一場中國功夫大師與日本武士的較量正式上演,比武場上陳真..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: When Chen Zhen travels to Japan to learn industrial technology, he teams up with martial artist She Zi Li, and accepts a duel challenge from the Japanese military officials to uphold the Chinese dignity. In a battle of Chinese kung fu master agianst the Japanese samurai, Chen showcases the unique finesse of Chinese kung fu.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 歡宜寨突然怪病橫行,為了救寨,守山人長生前去尋找傳說中的九色鹿王。另外,大月國王宮內已被妖後控制,太子延頤為了阻止妖後,也踏上尋找九色鹿王的道路。長和延二人在途中要不斷躲避妖後的追殺,幸好有小藜等人幫..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Huan Yi Village is hit by a strange disease while the Demon Queen controls the Palace, so Chang and Prince Yan are forced to seek out the legendary Nine-colour Deer King to save the people and stop the Demon Queen. Evading the Queens pursuit, they uncover the Deer Kings secret with their allies, restoring peace to the village and the kingdom.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 漫畫展上,宅男漫畫家郝萍穹意外與殺手肖白菜交換了身體。穹由廢柴變成擁有豐滿身材和超能力的少女,但他卻不斷被壞人追殺。白菜不用擔心受敵人襲擊,但她卻每天過著被追稿的生活。這換位人生讓他們更了解自己的能力..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bottom-ranking cartoonist Hao and killer Xiao accidentally swapped identities at a comic fair. Hao becomes a powerful girl but is pursued by villains, while Xiao is free from pursuit but must work on deadlines everyday. After knowing their capabilites and responsibilities, they resume their identities and team up to fight the villains.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Set in the late 90s in Harbin, Tie falls for Li while collecting debts from her father. Li is touched by Ties loyalty, kindness and desire for true love. Unfortunately, a sudden headache hits Tie and he gets into an argument with the boss of the debt collection agency, putting more strain on the relationship of the two lovers.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Tian Yi is destined to fail as an immortal in heaven. When he accidentally frees Snowy and makes her a demon, he wanders in hell for thousand years to right his wrong. After a series of hardships, Snowy and Tian Yi manages to get married, but the heavenly warriors attempt to arrest Snowy. Can the couple live happily ever after?

To arrest Master Tien, the captain of the narcotics team at Ping Jiang City volunteers to be an undercover in Master Tiens drug gang, resulting in a fierce combat.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Demon cult prevails in the Yun Sheng dynasty. The Emperor arranges the princess to marry General Bai Yi before he dies, but the princess wants to end her engagement. When the princess eventually falls for Bai, she is kidnapped by the demon cult and Bai is killed in a fight while trying to save her. Will the couple be separated forever?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 宋朝年間,法醫宋慈來到長汀縣任職。一天晚上,突然有一男一女同時喪命,宋得知後立刻介入調查,驗屍過後發現事有蹊蹺,並不是簡單的殺人案。此時宋想到了丹青,可以說在長汀縣沒有丹不知道的事情。倆人於是合作找尋..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the Song dynasty, Changdings newly appointed forensic scientist, Song Ci, probes into the sudden deaths of a man and a woman. His inquest reveals a mysterious murder plot, and Song Ci decides to join forces with Dan Qing, who knows everything about Changding County, to unravel the truth behind the murders.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 漁民子豪生活在海邊小鎮歸港,以捕魚為生。有一天,他偶然遇到一位神秘的女孩小藝,兩人互生情愫,終於走在一起。但好景不長,突然有一個名叫老金的神秘中年人到來,揭開了小藝真實的身份竟然是人魚族!子豪能否接受..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A fisherman Zi Hao lives in a small seaside town and earns a living on the water. One day, he finds himself enchanted by a mysterious woman Xiao Yi, and they fall in love.  However, a strange man appears and uncovers the true identity of Xiao Yi as a mermaid one day.  Can Zi Hao face the truth and can Xiao Yi keep the secret of the mermaid tribe?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 武狀元蘇燦在打擊販賣大煙的天門教鬥爭中意外受傷失憶,流落街頭淪為蘇乞兒,及後被金枝和小果母女收留。小果意外發現了配製好的鴉片膏,被天門教捉走。蘇乞兒為了救小果及避免鴉片禍害百姓,一舉破壞了天門教的..

The daughter is caught by the cult when she accidentally discovers the opium. Beggar Su joins the court to save the girl and destroy the cult, so as to stop the opiums harm on people.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 民國年間,日本特務吉岡意圖找到龍棺裡的徐福寶藏,便命人僱傭探險家陳啟龍尋找一本神秘的竹簡。陳在一座古墓中找到竹簡,及後得知是交給日本人,便搶回竹簡和傭金。根據竹簡上的指引,陳與夥伴們踏上蓬萊仙島尋找寶..

Chen finds the note but refuses to give it to the Japanese, keeping both the note and his pay. As Chen and his friends follow the instructions to an island where the treasure is concealed, they are unaware that a mysterious pursuit is about to begin.

The Monster Kings real purpose is to suck peoples blood and control the world through eudemon. Knowing his evil plan, Constable Xie decides to unlock his hidden power and begins a fierce battle with Monster King.
