epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 我們跟隨奧克蘭動物園的鳥類團隊進入科羅曼德山脈的荒野,他們協助拯救本土鷸鴕的數量.這是袋獾的獵食潮,大象團隊面臨至今為止最大的挑戰.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: We follow Auckland Zoos bird team into the wilds of the Coromandel Ranges as they help to save native kiwi populations, Its a feeding frenzy for the Tasmanian devils and the elephant team faces their biggest challenge yet.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本集探索世上最毒的動物,揭示毒物和毒液如何讓牠們在生存鬥爭中獲得競爭優勢.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This episode explores the worlds most toxic animals, revealing how poison and venom have given them the edge over the competition in their fight for survival.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 我們在本集將探索動物的溝通以及難以置信的適應能力,並揭示動物間能夠「交談」.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this episode we explore animal communication and reveal the incredible adaptations that enable animals to talk to each other.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 展示大自然一些最難以置信的動物頭腦,牠們的大腦顯現出高智慧,使牠們能在競爭中取得優勢.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Showcasing some of natures most incredible animal minds, whose brains demonstrate high intelligence, enabling them to gain advantage of their competition.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 安斯利前往臺灣,發現它是世上最偉大的美食聖地之一.他發現香燉魚和辣炒豬肉,並用大蒜和辣椒煮台灣大蝦.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ainsley travels to Taiwan and discovers it is one of the greatest food destinations in the world. He finds fragrant braised fish and chilli pork stir-fry, and cooks Taiwan prawns with garlic and chilli.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 安斯利發現馬德里是個充滿秘密的城市.首先這個沉迷美食的城市禁止街頭美食.那麼當地人如何繞過這道禁令呢?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ainsley discovers that Madrid is a city of secrets. The first one comes as a bit of a shock: street food is banned in this food-obsessed city. So how do the locals get round this?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 安斯利來到摩洛哥,但他沒有去馬拉喀什或卡薩布蘭加,而是去了豐富多彩、混亂而夢幻的費茲.雜亂無序的麥地那是世界遺產,也是通往另一個時代的門戶.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ainsley lands in Morocco, but he doesnt go to Marrakesch or Casablanca, but to the colourful, chaotic and dreamy city of Fes. The sprawling medina is a World Heritage site and a gateway to another time.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 自60年前導演的處女作面世,馬丁史柯西斯一生一直致力為電影的過去、現在和未來打拼.他被稱為「電影保母」,他不斷突破電影製作的極限.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: 60 years since his directorial debut, Martin Scorseses life has been dedicated to the past, present and future of cinema. Named Caretaker of Cinema, Martin Scorsese continues to push the boundaries of moviemaking.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 自90年代初,昆汀塔倫提諾一直乘坐從不減速的電影過山車,這也鞏固了他那世上最具影響力的電影製作人之一的地位.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Since the early 1990s, Quentin Tarantino has been on a cinematic rollercoaster ride, thats never looked like slowing down, that has cemented himself as one of the worlds most influential filmmakers.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 史派克李一直是位備受爭議和政治性的電影製作人,他的電影就是最好的證據.自40多年前處女作面世,他一直在美國突破界限.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Spike Lee has always been a controversial and political filmmaker whose films speak for themselves. Over 40 years since his debut in the world of film, Spike continues to push boundaries in America.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 關注碧昂絲諾爾斯卡特的人生和事業,從她早年擔任組合「天命真女」主唱到現在的單飛生涯.探討這位超級巨星多年來的音樂風格和靈感是如何演變的.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Follow the life and career of Beyoncé Knowles-Carter, from her early days as the lead singer of Destinys Child to her solo career. Discover how the superstars music style and inspirations have developed over the years.

epg.programme_title_tc: 珍娜·傑克森:誘惑的藝術
epg.programme_title_en: Janet Jackson: The Art Of Seduction
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 珍妮積遜以其強烈的獨立性、有吸力的氣質和迷人的嗓音而聞名,她在MTV的成長成為她的催化劑;接受她的身份,並到達明星的巔峰.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Noted for her fierce independence, her magnetic aura and her ever so charming voice, Janet Jackson became a catalyst for her growth on MTV; embracing her identity, and reaching up to the heights of stardom.

epg.programme_title_en: Samuel L. Jackson: Did I Stutter?
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 憑藉無出其右的職業道德,山繆傑克森作為電影史上最傑出人物之一的地位毋容置疑.這位仍然擄獲全球粉絲的心的漫威演員,一起跟進他的傳奇.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: With a work ethic like no other, its hard to doubt Samuel L. Jacksons status as one of the most prominent figures in cinematic history. Follow the legend of the marvel actor as he continues to capture the hearts of fans all world the over.

epg.programme_title_en: Bruce Lee: The Way Of The Warrior
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 李小龍,荷里活電影的標誌性人物,武術先驅,但最重要的是,他是一位朋友.《武者之路》全面審視,由最親近的人講述李小龍的傳奇.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bruce Lee, an iconic figure in Hollywood cinema, a pioneer of martial arts but most importantly, a friend. The Way of the Warrior takes a comprehensive look at the legend that is Bruce Lee, told by the people closest to him.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《阿姆斯壯》戲劇性、感人且富有洞察力地講述尼爾岩士唐最完整的人生故事—從他在俄亥俄州鄉村的童年到他首次登月—以及伴隨而來非他所願的名人地位.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Dramatic, moving and insightful, Armstrong tells the definitive life story of Neil Armstrong - from his childhood in rural Ohio, through aerial combat in Korea, to his first steps on the Moon - and the unwanted celebrity status that ensued.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 史派克李一直是位備受爭議和政治性的電影製作人,他的電影就是最好的證據.自40多年前處女作面世,他一直在美國突破界限.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Spike Lee has always been a controversial and political filmmaker whose films speak for themselves. Over 40 years since his debut in the world of film, Spike continues to push boundaries in America.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 祖拜登於2021年1月20日就任美國第46任總統,承諾在分裂的時代後團結和鎮靜,目標是「恢復美國魂」.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Joe Biden became the 46th US President on Jan 20, 2021, promising unity and calm after a divided era, aiming to restore the soul of America.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 當川普的總統任期(2017-2021)在一片爭議和社會變革中過渡,對國家和世界產生了良久影響.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Donald Trumps presidency (2017-2021) was marked by controversy and societal shifts, leaving a lasting impact on the nation and world.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這部紀錄片系列展示五代噴射機.這些戰機能夠攜帶炸彈並飛近太空邊緣.第六代戰機從2020年開始服役,第11季至今已經覆蓋了大部分此後的空中兵器.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 傾聽大自然隱藏的聲音.跨越五大洲,全球專家從婆羅洲的森林到玻里尼西亞的大海,追蹤令人驚嘆的聲學信號,探索我們生命生態系統中無與倫比的聲音景觀.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Listen to the hidden sounds of nature. Across five continents, world experts track surprising acoustic signals from Borneos forests to Polynesias seas, exploring the incredible soundscape of our living ecosystems.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Listen to the hidden sounds of nature. Across five continents, world experts track surprising acoustic signals from Borneos forests to Polynesias seas, exploring the incredible soundscape of our living ecosystems.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ainsley lands in Morocco, but he doesnt go to Marrakesch or Casablanca, but to the colourful, chaotic and dreamy city of Fes. The sprawling medina is a World Heritage site and a gateway to another time.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 安斯利到訪檳島首都喬治敦,馬來西亞人發現這個沉迷美食的國家中最好的街頭食品.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ainsley visits Georgetown, the capital of Penang island, where Malaysians come to discover the best street food in this food-obsessed country.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 安斯利在美食之旅的最後一站到訪問約旦的安曼,那是來自伊拉克、黎巴嫩、巴勒斯坦和敘利亞中東一族叫作家的交匯處.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: On the final leg of his culinary journey, Ainsley visits Amman in Jordan, the crossroads in the Middle East that families from Iraq, Lebanon, Palestine and Syria now call home.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《生存邊緣》探索人類有史以來面臨的最大存亡風險之一的未來- 一個生化威脅.從病毒到人造流行病和合成生化武器,科技正加速人造威脅的風險.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Edge of Existence explores a future where bio-threats present one of the greatest existential risks that humanity has ever faced. From viruses to man-made pandemics and synthetic bio-weapons, technology is accelerating the risks of man-made threats.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《生存邊緣》探索一個近未來,人工智能統治著地球和我們.人工智能將伴隨我們一生,並帶來人類史上所面臨的最大存亡風險.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Edge of Existence explores a near-future where artificial intelligence rules the planet, and us. AI will arrive in our life-times bringing with it the biggest existential risk humanity has ever faced.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《生存邊緣》檢視全球生物圈所面臨的存亡威脅,以及對地球和奧特亞羅瓦(紐西蘭)的未來代表著甚麼.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Edge of Existence examines existential threats to the worlds biosphere and what it means for the future of the planet, and Aotearoa.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 準備好迎接一場史詩般的紐約美食大探險吧!賈斯汀(Justine)來到 Russ  Daughters 品嚐招牌貝果,沉浸在德卡爾布市場(DeKalb Market)充滿活力的熱鬧氛圍中,並大口享用經典的紐約切片披薩.這為終極的美食冒險拉開了激動人心且風味十足的序幕!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Get ready for an epic NY food quest! Justine hits Russ  Daughters for iconic bagels, soaks in the vibrant buzz of DeKalb Market, and devours a classic slice of New York pizza. A thrilling, flavor-packed kickoff to the ultimate culinary adventure!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 味蕾之旅大爆發!賈斯汀探索了美國烹飪學院(Culinary Institute),在 Essies 餐廳品嚐了融合加勒比海與美國南方風味的大膽創意料理,並買了香甜的義大利奶油甜餡煎餅卷(cannolis).在風景如畫的白脫牛奶瀑布(Buttermilk Falls)野餐後,她前往傳奇的 Moose
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The flavor journey explodes! Justine explores the Culinary Institute, tastes bold Caribbean-Southern fusion at Essies, and grabs sweet cannolis. After a scenic picnic at Buttermilk Falls, she dines at the legendary Moosewood Restaurant!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一場狂野的市場之旅正等著您!賈斯汀一頭栽進鹽城市場(Salt City Market),在奧農達加湖(Onondaga Lake)湖畔烹調墨西哥捲餅,並大啖煙燻風味的 Dinosaur BBQ 烤肉.最後,她在風景優美的卡南代瓜(Canandaigua)享用黏糊糊的花生醬烤棉花糖巧克力夾心餅(sm
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A wild market tour awaits! Justine dives into Salt City Market, cooks lakeside burritos at Onondaga Lake, and feasts on smoky Dinosaur BBQ. She tops off this mouthwatering day with gooey peanut butter smores in scenic Canandaigua!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 美食驚喜持續不斷!賈斯汀將當地 Living Roots 酒莊的葡萄酒與豐盛的義式玉米糊(polenta)完美搭配,欣賞令人嘆為觀止的尼加拉瀑布(Niagara Falls),並造訪指標性的 Anchor Bar,大口品嚐最正宗的水牛城辣雞翅!純粹的美味與令人驚豔的美景在此完美交會.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Gourmet thrills roll on! Justine pairs local Living Roots wines with hearty polenta, takes in breathtaking Niagara Falls, and visits the iconic Anchor Bar to devour the original Buffalo wing! Pure flavor meets jaw-dropping sights.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 賈斯汀在水牛城大啖經典的烤牛肉午餐,隨後乘船啟航,前往壯麗的千島群島(1000 Islands)和博爾特城堡(Boldt Castle)!在風景如畫的水域沿岸一邊烹飪、一邊探索,最後她在奢華的薩加莫爾度假村(Sagamore Resort)為這難忘的一天畫上休止符.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Justine tackles a classic roast beef lunch in Buffalo before setting sail for the magnificent 1000 Islands and Boldt Castle! Cooking and exploring along scenic waters, she caps off an unforgettable day at the luxurious Sagamore Resort.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 盛大的壓軸好戲火熱登場!賈斯汀在 Toad Hill 楓糖農場搭配新鮮糖漿製作了蘋果煎餅,接著大啖薩拉托加(Saratoga)炸雞,最後在 River Market Bar and Kitchen 享用了一頓令人難忘的最終盛宴,為她這場史詩般的紐約冒險帶來最完美的加冕!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The grand finale sizzles! Justine whips up apple pancakes with fresh syrup at Toad Hill Maple Farm, digs into Saratoga fried chicken, and crowns her epic New York adventure with an unforgettable final feast at River Market Bar and Kitchen!

epg.programme_title_en: A New Zealand Food Story S3 #1
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 班的美食故事之旅從南方深處開展,他在當地瞭解到為何羊肉如此美味.他認識到最早出產松露的先驅,又乘坐直升機在菲奧德蘭國家公園尋找馬鹿.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bens food story journey starts in the deep south where he learns why lamb tastes so good. He meets the earliest pioneers producing truffles and travels by helicopter into Fiordland in search of Wapiti.

epg.programme_title_en: A New Zealand Food Story S3 #2
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 班到北地大區旅行並瞭解當地的紅酒.他發現一個花生農場,遇到種熱帶木瓜的人,又結識一班以前所未有方式培育紐西蘭黃尾鰤的科學家.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ben travels to Northland and learns about wine in the region. He discovers a peanut farm, meets tropical papaya fruit growers and catches up with a team of scientists cultivating kingfish like never before.

epg.programme_title_en: A New Zealand Food Story S3 #3
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 蘆筍當造 - 班挑選3個品種.他遇到一位農民,瞭解到穀飼牛的好處.班追隨注重自耕蔬果的「土壤姐妹」運動.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Its asparagus season – Ben picks the 3 varieties. He meets a farmer and understands the benefits of grass-fed beef. Ben catches up with the Soil Sisters a movement focussed on growing your own fruit and vegetables.

epg.programme_title_en: A New Zealand Food Story S3 #4
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 班參觀可持續養殖的綠殼青口養殖場,又參觀花生醬工廠.他到坎特伯雷見一個鴕鳥農夫,並第一次烹煮鴕鳥!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ben checks out a sustainably farmed Green Shell Mussel Farm and visits a peanut butter factory. He travels to Canterbury to meet an ostrich farmer and cooks ostrich for the first time ever!

epg.programme_title_en: A New Zealand Food Story S3 #5
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 班遇見一位琴酒釀造者和一位義大利肉店商,並讚揚一位致力於永續農產原則的釀酒師.班擠羊奶,並瞭解下一代農夫如何打造多元化業務.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ben meets a Gin maker, an Italian chacutier and celebrates a wine maker committed to the principles of sustainable farming. Ben milks sheep and learns how next generation farmers are diversifying their business.

epg.programme_title_en: A New Zealand Food Story S3 #6
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 班體驗製作芝士的藝術.他遇到一位甜椒生產商並瞭解洋蔥的起源.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ben experiences the art of cheese making. He meets a capsicum producer and learns about the provenance of the onion.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 當川普的總統任期(2017-2021)在一片爭議和社會變革中過渡,對國家和世界產生了良久影響.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Donald Trumps presidency (2017-2021) was marked by controversy and societal shifts, leaving a lasting impact on the nation and world.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 巴拉克歐巴馬是首位非裔美國總統,體現了希望、正義、寬容和平等,以他的信息和傳承啟發數百萬人.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Barack Obama, the 1st African-American US President, embodied hope, justice, tolerance, and equality, inspiring millions with his message and legacy.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 探索比爾柯林頓複雜的影響,從阿肯色州起家到白宮的高山(經濟繁榮)與低谷(醜聞、彈劾),以及他對美國政治的影響.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Explore Bill Clintons complex legacy, from Arkansas roots to White House highs (economic prosperity) and lows (scandals, impeachment), and his impact on American politics.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這部紀錄片系列展示五代噴射機.這些戰機能夠攜帶炸彈並飛近太空邊緣.第六代戰機從2020年開始服役,第11季至今已經覆蓋了大部分此後的空中兵器.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This documentary series shows five generations of jet engines. These fighter jets are capable of carrying bombs and soar close to the edge of space. The sixth generation of fighter jets began in 2020, and the 11th season has covered most of the air a

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這部紀錄片系列展示五代噴射機.這些戰機能夠攜帶炸彈並飛近太空邊緣.第六代戰機從2020年開始服役,第11季至今已經覆蓋了大部分此後的空中兵器.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This documentary series shows five generations of jet engines. These fighter jets are capable of carrying bombs and soar close to the edge of space. The sixth generation of fighter jets began in 2020, and the 11th season has covered most of the air a

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 味蕾之旅大爆發!賈斯汀探索了美國烹飪學院(Culinary Institute),在 Essies 餐廳品嚐了融合加勒比海與美國南方風味的大膽創意料理,並買了香甜的義大利奶油甜餡煎餅卷(cannolis).在風景如畫的白脫牛奶瀑布(Buttermilk Falls)野餐後,她前往傳奇的 Moose
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The flavor journey explodes! Justine explores the Culinary Institute, tastes bold Caribbean-Southern fusion at Essies, and grabs sweet cannolis. After a scenic picnic at Buttermilk Falls, she dines at the legendary Moosewood Restaurant!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一場狂野的市場之旅正等著您!賈斯汀一頭栽進鹽城市場(Salt City Market),在奧農達加湖(Onondaga Lake)湖畔烹調墨西哥捲餅,並大啖煙燻風味的 Dinosaur BBQ 烤肉.最後,她在風景優美的卡南代瓜(Canandaigua)享用黏糊糊的花生醬烤棉花糖巧克力夾心餅(sm
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A wild market tour awaits! Justine dives into Salt City Market, cooks lakeside burritos at Onondaga Lake, and feasts on smoky Dinosaur BBQ. She tops off this mouthwatering day with gooey peanut butter smores in scenic Canandaigua!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 美食驚喜持續不斷!賈斯汀將當地 Living Roots 酒莊的葡萄酒與豐盛的義式玉米糊(polenta)完美搭配,欣賞令人嘆為觀止的尼加拉瀑布(Niagara Falls),並造訪指標性的 Anchor Bar,大口品嚐最正宗的水牛城辣雞翅!純粹的美味與令人驚豔的美景在此完美交會.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Gourmet thrills roll on! Justine pairs local Living Roots wines with hearty polenta, takes in breathtaking Niagara Falls, and visits the iconic Anchor Bar to devour the original Buffalo wing! Pure flavor meets jaw-dropping sights.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 賈斯汀在水牛城大啖經典的烤牛肉午餐,隨後乘船啟航,前往壯麗的千島群島(1000 Islands)和博爾特城堡(Boldt Castle)!在風景如畫的水域沿岸一邊烹飪、一邊探索,最後她在奢華的薩加莫爾度假村(Sagamore Resort)為這難忘的一天畫上休止符.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Justine tackles a classic roast beef lunch in Buffalo before setting sail for the magnificent 1000 Islands and Boldt Castle! Cooking and exploring along scenic waters, she caps off an unforgettable day at the luxurious Sagamore Resort.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 盛大的壓軸好戲火熱登場!賈斯汀在 Toad Hill 楓糖農場搭配新鮮糖漿製作了蘋果煎餅,接著大啖薩拉托加(Saratoga)炸雞,最後在 River Market Bar and Kitchen 享用了一頓令人難忘的最終盛宴,為她這場史詩般的紐約冒險帶來最完美的加冕!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The grand finale sizzles! Justine whips up apple pancakes with fresh syrup at Toad Hill Maple Farm, digs into Saratoga fried chicken, and crowns her epic New York adventure with an unforgettable final feast at River Market Bar and Kitchen!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在智利托雷斯德爾潘恩,雪山融水注入指狀峽灣,延伸至海洋並匯入洋流,降低海水鹽度.河口、濕地孕育眾多涉禽,而無數海灣與港口則吸引稀有的海豚與虎鯨.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Chiles Torres del Paine melt from snow-covered mountains feeds finger-like fjords as they reach out to the sea to join the current lowering its salinity. Rivers estuaries and wetlands are home to many wading birds and the countless inlets and bay

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 洪堡洋流雖比多數洋流緩慢,卻是世界上最具活力的洋流之一,因其行經距離極長.深海海溝的湧升流將養分帶至海面,使浮游植物大量繁盛,奠定複雜海洋食物鏈的基礎.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Humboldt Current is slower than most ocean currents but its the most dynamic in the world because it travels for such a long distance. Upwelling from the deepest trenches brings nutrients to the surface allowing phytoplankton to bloom laying the

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這股洋流伴隨著智利獨特的藍鯨族群,也是其他極度稀有海洋哺乳動物的最後避風港.從冰冷深海到高崖強風,洋流塑造出奇特棲地,也是一部關於生存的自然研究.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The current is followed by a unique population of Chilean blue whales and is the last refuge for other extremely rare marine mammals. From the chill of its deepest depths to the wind on its highest cliffs the current creates unusual habitats and is a

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 安斯利在美食之旅的最後一站到訪問約旦的安曼,那是來自伊拉克、黎巴嫩、巴勒斯坦和敘利亞中東一族叫作家的交匯處.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: On the final leg of his culinary journey, Ainsley visits Amman in Jordan, the crossroads in the Middle East that families from Iraq, Lebanon, Palestine and Syria now call home.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明來到母親的家鄉北京,在中國這個古老國家開展烹飪、歷史和個人之旅.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam Liaw arrives in his mums home town of Beijing to begin a culinary, historical and personal journey through the ancient country of China.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 崇明參觀了山巒起伏的美麗省份- 安徽,這是中國八大菜系之一的故鄉.徽菜是誠懇的農家菜,採用時令山野食材烹調而成.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam visits the beautiful, mountainous province of Anhui, home to one of the eight great regional cuisines of China. Anhui cuisine is hearty, peasant food that uses seasonal, wild produce from the mountains.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 崇明繼續透過美食探索中國歷史的旅程,他到訪江蘇省和浙江省,它們也位列中國八大菜系之中,並以其豐盛和精緻而聞名.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adams journey to explore Chinas history through its food continues, as he visits the provinces of Jiangsu and Zhejiang, both considered part of the 8 great regional cuisines of China and celebrated for their wealth and sophistication.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明抵訪世上最大的城市之一上海,他在當地發現一個現代化、國際化、全球化的城市.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam Liaw arrives in one of the largest cities in the world Shanghai where he discovers a modern, cosmopolitan and global facing city.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《生存邊緣》檢視全球生物圈所面臨的存亡威脅,以及對地球和奧特亞羅瓦(紐西蘭)的未來代表著甚麼.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Edge of Existence examines existential threats to the worlds biosphere and what it means for the future of the planet, and Aotearoa.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《生存邊緣》探索人類有史以來面臨的最大存亡風險之一的未來- 一個生化威脅.從病毒到人造流行病和合成生化武器,科技正加速人造威脅的風險.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Edge of Existence explores a future where bio-threats present one of the greatest existential risks that humanity has ever faced. From viruses to man-made pandemics and synthetic bio-weapons, technology is accelerating the risks of man-made threats.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《生存邊緣》探索一個近未來,人工智能統治著地球和我們.人工智能將伴隨我們一生,並帶來人類史上所面臨的最大存亡風險.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Edge of Existence explores a near-future where artificial intelligence rules the planet, and us. AI will arrive in our life-times bringing with it the biggest existential risk humanity has ever faced.

epg.programme_title_tc: 重機夢想家之基努李維 #7
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在挪威,前衛建築師謝提爾.托森以顛覆性的思維重新定義建築——從可行走的歌劇院到沉入海中的餐廳,他的設計挑戰我們對空間的想像.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Norway, visionary architect Kjetil Thorsen is redefining the way we think about buildings and architecture with an Opera House that you can walk on and a restaurant that plunges into the sea.

epg.programme_title_tc: 重機夢想家之基努李維 #8
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ARCH 的旅程是一場關於好奇心的探索——理解靈感為何而來.在拜訪世界各地的創意先鋒後,基努與加德回到 ARCH,回顧一路上獲得的啟發與體悟.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Arch journey is about curiosity - understanding why inspiration strikes. After meeting with visionaries around the world, Keanu and Gard return to Arch to debrief the lessons learned.

epg.programme_title_tc: 前進宇宙:太空、競賽、火星與更遠之處
epg.programme_title_en: Into the Cosmos: The Space Race, Mars And Beyond
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 看看太空旅行的發展,以及人類某天踏足火星的潛力.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A look at the development of space travel and the potential for humans to one day walk on the surface of Mars.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 2009 年 5 月,麥克斯·「Notch」·佩爾森(Markus Notch Persson)推出了一款名為《麥塊》(Minecraft)的獨立小品遊戲.憑藉直覺式的玩法與無窮的創造力,它一路席捲全球,從一個簡單的個人副業計畫,蛻變為史上最暢銷的電子遊戲,成就一段震撼全球的驚人現象!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In May 2009, Markus Notch Persson launched a humble indie game named Minecraft. With intuitive play and infinite creativity, it became the best-selling video game of all time—evolving from a simple side project into a massive global phenomenon!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 隨著電子遊戲崛起,科技巨頭索尼嘗試與任天堂合作.但在一次驚人的背叛後,索尼創立了後來成為世上最成功的遊戲主機.Playstation從此屹立不倒.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: With video-games on the rise, Sony, the tech superpower would attempt a collaboration with Nintendo. After a shocking betrayal, Sony founded what would become the worlds most successful chain of video game consoles. The Playstation was here to stay.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 由製造「花札」卡牌默默發跡,到成為世上最受認可的電子遊戲公司之一,從瑪利歐和路易吉的誕生到大金剛和薩爾達⋯⋯到擊敗競爭對手並成為高品質遊戲和強大價值的平台.這就是任天堂的故事.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From humble beginnings manufacturing Hanufuda cards came one of the worlds most recognised videogame companies and presenting itself as a platform for quality games and strong values. This is the story of Nintendo.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 探索比爾柯林頓複雜的影響,從阿肯色州起家到白宮的高山(經濟繁榮)與低谷(醜聞、彈劾),以及他對美國政治的影響.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Explore Bill Clintons complex legacy, from Arkansas roots to White House highs (economic prosperity) and lows (scandals, impeachment), and his impact on American politics.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本紀錄片審視喬治小布希的總統任期,尤其是伊拉克戰爭、其後遺症以及他的決定帶來的持久影響,包括伊斯蘭國的崛起和衝突造成的傷亡.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Documentary examines George W. Bushs presidency, focusing on the Iraq War, its aftermath, and the lasting impact of his decisions, including the rise of ISIS and the human toll of the conflict.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 朗奴雷根是一位有魅力的領袖,他用列根經濟學將美國轉營,在國內外有著不同意見,又用他富有遠見的政策和標誌性的演講永遠改變保守主義.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ronald Reagan, a charismatic leader, transformed America with Reaganomics, dividing opinion at home and abroad, and forever changing Conservatism with his visionary policies and iconic speeches.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在挪威,前衛建築師謝提爾.托森以顛覆性的思維重新定義建築——從可行走的歌劇院到沉入海中的餐廳,他的設計挑戰我們對空間的想像.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Norway, visionary architect Kjetil Thorsen is redefining the way we think about buildings and architecture with an Opera House that you can walk on and a restaurant that plunges into the sea.

epg.programme_title_tc: 重機夢想家之基努李維 #8
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ARCH 的旅程是一場關於好奇心的探索——理解靈感為何而來.在拜訪世界各地的創意先鋒後,基努與加德回到 ARCH,回顧一路上獲得的啟發與體悟.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Arch journey is about curiosity - understanding why inspiration strikes. After meeting with visionaries around the world, Keanu and Gard return to Arch to debrief the lessons learned.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 看看太空旅行的發展,以及人類某天踏足火星的潛力.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A look at the development of space travel and the potential for humans to one day walk on the surface of Mars.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Brother Hui, who runs an amphibian and reptile store in Xinxing District, Kaohsiung City, has a wide range of knowledge in the field of reptiles. He started with red-eared sliders and gradually got in touch with tortoises, lizards, snakes and other reptile pets. In Brother Hui's brick-and-mortar store, the most special existence is the two store pets, the South American lizards. The male is called Meatball and the female is called Porkball. How did their fate with Brother Hui begin? Brother Hui, who has many years of experience in raising South American lizards, also generously share his breeding secrets. How to distinguish male and female South American lizards? How to keep them healthy? What's the secret to taming them? In this epsiode, we unpack the living environment of South American lizards and reveal the breeding guide!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: The era of high housing prices shocks the masses. However, some are willing to live in the mountains for their beloved parrots, just to give them the best breeding environment. Parrots have a long lifespan and their IQ is comparable to that of a five-year-old child. How do you make them behave? Training is actually a good way, but how? "Melon seeds" are key to the goal. If you want to raise a parrot, there are in fact many restrictions on choosing the right one. How should I put it? Don’t miss “Cute Pet Guide”!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: The Call duck is a domestic duck species native to the Netherlands. Males can weigh about 570 to 680 grams. Because its call is different from other ducks, Call Ducks were bred as hunting ducks, now most of them are used as pets. They mainly live in the Netherlands, Japan, and Southeast Asia. They were introduced to the pet market in recent years and were originally used by European hunters to lure wild ducks using their call. Their ducklings are described as having fair skin, big breasts and round butts. They can heal people's moods, and their cute appearance adds joy.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc:
Ali the elephant at Shoushan Zoo, carries the childhood memories of many children, both young and old. Although he is now 49 years old, he is still energetic under the care of the keepers. Once the new zoo is completed, the public will be able to see "Ali" again. When the caregiver helps Ali take a shower, Ali will take the opportunity to replenish his body with water; sometimes he will step on water in the pool and use his nose to enjoy the fun of playing in the water. 
There are currently only three African elephants in Taiwan. In addition to Ali, the other two are in the Taipei City Zoo. Because African elephants are endangered wild animals, their import and export are strictly controlled. If these three elephants die in the future, Taiwan may no longer see any African elephants. Shoushan Zoo vows to take good care of "Ali" so that "Ali's" heartwarming story can continue, and shoulder the mission of life education, so that everyone's visit to the Shoushan Zoo is the starting point of happy memories. In addition to Ali the elephant, Shoushan Zoo currently has two white rhinos, male "Xiqi" from the Taipei City Zoo and female "Baby" who was bred naturally in the zoo. 
White rhino "Xiqi" was loaned to Shoushan Zoo in hope that he could successfully mate with the female white rhino "Baby" to raise the white rhino population.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: It is one of China's most revered mountains. A religious center to this day for numerous sects of Chinese Buddhism, Emei Mountain was once the battle ground where Buddhism once clashed with one of China's leading religions at the time – Taoism. From the celestial revelations that led to the dawn of this religion on Emei mountain, through the legends of the White Snake, and to the religious ceremonies that brought an Emperor his heir, Emei mountain remains one of China's most illustrious religious hubs, where pilgrimages take place to this day. Discover China unveils the secrets behind Buddhism's rise to power, in the Tides between Taoism & Buddhism.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: It is one of China's most revered mountains. A religious center to this day for numerous sects of Chinese Buddhism, Emei Mountain was once the battle ground where Buddhism once clashed with one of China's leading religions at the time – Taoism. From the celestial revelations that led to the dawn of this religion on Emei mountain, through the legends of the White Snake, and to the religious ceremonies that brought an Emperor his heir, Emei mountain remains one of China's most illustrious religious hubs, where pilgrimages take place to this day. Discover China unveils the secrets behind Buddhism's rise to power, in the Tides between Taoism & Buddhism.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: The suicide of a woman shocked an entire village. It jolted an entire province, and word of her death even reached the imperial court. Upon hearing of the reasons behind this woman’s untimely death, the emperor decreed a magnificent arch be built in her memory, earning her family, her village and her province an honor of the highest degree. These beautiful arches, which dot China’s scenery, are the culmination of a culture founded on the remembrance of those who achieved a higher moral status than the rest of society, those who were chaste and remained pure, even in their deaths. Discover China passes on the story of Memorial Arches.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: At the turn of the century, a Child-Emperor ascended to the throne of the Chinese Qing Dynasty. Emperor Pu-Yi’s Reign was short lived and mired with treason, corruption and external influences. After abdicating his throne, Pu Yi knew his days in the imperial palace were numbered. Questions of his survival as a commoner began to trouble his mind. Upon looking at the wealth of priceless artifacts collected over 500 years of imperial reign, Pu Yi began plotting ways to smuggle these riches out. However, Pu Yi was not alone. Discover China brings you the story of how the precious treasures of the Imperial City disappeared from the capital palace, and where some reside today.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: At the turn of the century, a Child-Emperor ascended to the throne of the Chinese Qing Dynasty. Emperor Pu-Yi’s Reign was short lived and mired with treason, corruption and external influences. After abdicating his throne, Pu Yi knew his days in the imperial palace were numbered. Questions of his survival as a commoner began to trouble his mind. Upon looking at the wealth of priceless artifacts collected over 500 years of imperial reign, Pu Yi began plotting ways to smuggle these riches out. However, Pu Yi was not alone. Discover China brings you the story of how the precious treasures of the Imperial City disappeared from the capital palace, and where some reside today.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: At the foot of Tai Mountain sits an enigma – it is a temple, dedicated to the god of Tai Mountain, yet it bears a striking resemblance to an imperial palace. The secrets behind this grand and lavish temple lie in a ceremonial farce, carried out by a brazen and ambitious emperor, who would not heed his country's desperate situation and instead tried to bolster his status as sole ruler. As time passed, and this emperor's remains turned to ashes, all that remains from this fantastic episode in China's history is this stunning shrine. Discover China uncovers the secrets of this temple and the ceremonies which brought it to life, in The Emperor's Fantasy.

After centuries of development and integration a new generation and ethnic group were formed- The Naxi. Leading a peaceful life; the Naxi’s rare and enchanting culture has a strict belief in living harmoniously with nature. The Old Town of Lijiang, is a relaxed, graceful and tranquil setting. Join us, as Discover China visits Old Town Lijiang.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: To escape war, the Qiang people settled down by the water at the foot of the Yulong Mountains. After centuries of development and integration a new generation and ethnic group were formed- The Naxi. Leading a peaceful life; the Naxi’s rare and enchanting culture has a strict belief in living harmoniously with nature. The Old Town of Lijiang, is a relaxed, graceful and tranquil setting.  Full of nature’s elegance, where the Naxi people have made a home for themselves, where they can practice their unique form of faith and enjoy the prosperity of their geographical position. Join us, as Discover China visits Old Town Lijiang.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: It is one of China's most revered mountains. A religious center to this day for numerous sects of Chinese Buddhism, Emei Mountain was once the battle ground where Buddhism once clashed with one of China's leading religions at the time – Taoism. From the celestial revelations that led to the dawn of this religion on Emei mountain, through the legends of the White Snake, and to the religious ceremonies that brought an Emperor his heir, Emei mountain remains one of China's most illustrious religious hubs, where pilgrimages take place to this day. Discover China unveils the secrets behind Buddhism's rise to power, in the Tides between Taoism & Buddhism.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: The suicide of a woman shocked an entire village. It jolted an entire province, and word of her death even reached the imperial court. Upon hearing of the reasons behind this woman’s untimely death, the emperor decreed a magnificent arch be built in her memory, earning her family, her village and her province an honor of the highest degree. These beautiful arches, which dot China’s scenery, are the culmination of a culture founded on the remembrance of those who achieved a higher moral status than the rest of society, those who were chaste and remained pure, even in their deaths. Discover China passes on the story of Memorial Arches.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Continuing his quest for belief, host Tevya get's a fresh look at the history and traditions of the Hasidic Jews (a little different to the Judaism he was used to). Rabbi Kaplan and some new friends offer insight into the most important passage in a Jewish boy's life, the Bar Mitzvah, celebrate Purim and have dinner with the Rabbi's family. Can Rabbi Kaplan reveal the answer to one of the burning questions - why can't Jews eat bacon?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: A Swiss Italian television crew was in Kabul in the days leading up to the surrender and was able to document the growing anguish of a society that feels the end of a hope cultivated for twenty years. Social, civil and democratic achievements, especially those made by women, are being swept away. It is also the starting point for a reflection on the fight against terrorism.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Though separated by a stretch of sea, Glasgow and Belfast share elements of political, sporting and religious culture rooted in the difficult, unresolved events faced by the Irish community during the twentieth century. The Huddle tells the stories of two Irish communities brought together by a devotion to the Celtic Football Club, and a shared faith in football. Exploring the contradictions between two cities facing radical ideological divides yet brought together by full stadiums, these are the interwoven and personal accounts of journalists, musicians, political militants, IRA fighters—all united by their love of football—on what it means to be Irish.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Discover China is a documentary series shot in conjunction with the Chinese Ministry of Culture and China Central Television, including footage of never before seen locations and recreations of historical events. It was shot by BBC film crews over a four year period. At the foot of Tai Mountain sits an enigma, a temple that bears a striking resemblance to an Imperial palace. It was built by a brazen emperor, who ignored his country's desparation, and built this lavish shrine to bolster his status as the sole ruler.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Someone in Japan is in love with Switzerland, its culture, its folklore and, more specifically: the Swiss alphorn! The Tamagawa Alphorn Club from Nanasawa, Japan, is travelling to Switzerland to attend the International Alphorn Festival in Nendaz at the end of July. Alphorn playing started to be known in Japan in the 80ies and is becoming more and more popular in the last decade among retired people, but not only. Shigetoshi Nakagawa, founder of the group and a forest expert, is one of the first people who started to play the instrument; he has instructed to build and play the Alphorn in numerous regions, among children and elderly people. Thousands of Alphorn Clubs have been born lately and more and more Japanese are being interested in Swiss folklore culture and Switzerland in general.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: K2 is widely seen as the world's harshest mountain. Yet many indigenous porters make a living in its extreme conditions, carrying provisions for foreign climbing expeditions. Often risking their lives with only rudimentary equipment, they receive minimal pay for their efforts. Against a backdrop of breathtaking natural beauty, this cinematic doc explores the everyday courage and sacrifice of the men who call the 'Savage Mountain' their home.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: K2 is widely seen as the world's harshest mountain. Yet many indigenous porters make a living in its extreme conditions, carrying provisions for foreign climbing expeditions. Often risking their lives with only rudimentary equipment, they receive minimal pay for their efforts. Against a backdrop of breathtaking natural beauty, this cinematic doc explores the everyday courage and sacrifice of the men who call the 'Savage Mountain' their home.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Discover China is a documentary series shot in conjunction with the Chinese Ministry of Culture and China Central Television, including footage of never before seen locations and recreations of historical events. It was shot by BBC film crews over a four year period. At the foot of Tai Mountain sits an enigma, a temple that bears a striking resemblance to an Imperial palace. It was built by a brazen emperor, who ignored his country's desparation, and built this lavish shrine to bolster his status as the sole ruler.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Someone in Japan is in love with Switzerland, its culture, its folklore and, more specifically: the Swiss alphorn! The Tamagawa Alphorn Club from Nanasawa, Japan, is travelling to Switzerland to attend the International Alphorn Festival in Nendaz at the end of July. Alphorn playing started to be known in Japan in the 80ies and is becoming more and more popular in the last decade among retired people, but not only. Shigetoshi Nakagawa, founder of the group and a forest expert, is one of the first people who started to play the instrument; he has instructed to build and play the Alphorn in numerous regions, among children and elderly people. Thousands of Alphorn Clubs have been born lately and more and more Japanese are being interested in Swiss folklore culture and Switzerland in general.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: It is the most serious scandal ever hitting the modern art market. An affair that has made experts and auction houses tremble and has re-proposed the ghost of forgery. The facts date back to 2017 in Genoa, where an exhibition dedicated to the painter Amedeo Modigliani from Livorno was closed by the Public Prosecutor’s Office, which put 21 paintings out of the 60 on display under seizure.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Following the break up of the Soviet union, a gang of children from broken homes made a new life together inside the derelict buildings of a once secret weapons manufacturing city. In their childhood innocence, they thought they were living a fairytale dream of freedom, but with starvation and sub zero temperatures crippling their health, reality soon hit home. Despite their efforts to care for one another, three members of their group died. For the survivors: they must try against hopeless odds to turn their lives around.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: In 2011, six police officers in Fullerton, California, beat Kelly Thomas, a homeless schizophrenic man, so badly that he died of his injuries. Three years later, protests in Hollywood sparked after the officers were acquitted or had their charges dropped. Renowned filmmaker Dylan Avery attended the protest and, before he knew it, he was swept up into a world of grieving family members, retired police officers that now criticize the very system they used to serve, and civilians who have suffered brutality at the hands of those sworn to protect. Over the next two years, Avery followed multiple cases and developments that coincided with historic protests on the streets of Ferguson and Baltimore against institutionalized police racism and brutality.

epg.programme_title_tc: The Rapture Of Free Soloing On Acid
epg.programme_title_en: The Rapture Of Free Soloing On Acid
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: This film follows the legendary climbing photographer and Stone Master, Dean Fidelman. Fidelman was at the forefront of the free climbing revolution in Yosemite Valley and Joshua Tree during the 1970s, making photographs with John Bachar, Lynn Hill, Ron Kauk, John Long, and many other talented climbers. Over the past four decades, Fidelman has continued to document the evolution of rock climbing as a sport and culture. This documentary takes a look at his impact and influence as a photographer and climber.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: On January 6 2021, the sacred symbol of American democracy was stormed by armed supporters of Donald Trump, unleashing violence and destruction and leaving five dead. Who was behind this failed coup, and can faith in American democracy be restored?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Continuing his quest for belief, host Tevya get's a fresh look at the history and traditions of the Hasidic Jews (a little different to the Judaism he was used to). Rabbi Kaplan and some new friends offer insight into the most important passage in a Jewish boy's life, the Bar Mitzvah, celebrate Purim and have dinner with the Rabbi's family. Can Rabbi Kaplan reveal the answer to one of the burning questions - why can't Jews eat bacon?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: A Swiss Italian television crew was in Kabul in the days leading up to the surrender and was able to document the growing anguish of a society that feels the end of a hope cultivated for twenty years. Social, civil and democratic achievements, especially those made by women, are being swept away. It is also the starting point for a reflection on the fight against terrorism.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Though separated by a stretch of sea, Glasgow and Belfast share elements of political, sporting and religious culture rooted in the difficult, unresolved events faced by the Irish community during the twentieth century. The Huddle tells the stories of two Irish communities brought together by a devotion to the Celtic Football Club, and a shared faith in football. Exploring the contradictions between two cities facing radical ideological divides yet brought together by full stadiums, these are the interwoven and personal accounts of journalists, musicians, political militants, IRA fighters—all united by their love of football—on what it means to be Irish.

So a specialized training exercise was developed to provide pilots with the same combat missions they could expect in their first 10 missions. The results are incredible.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Continuing his quest for belief, host Tevya get's a fresh look at the history and traditions of the Hasidic Jews (a little different to the Judaism he was used to). Rabbi Kaplan and some new friends offer insight into the most important passage in a Jewish boy's life, the Bar Mitzvah, celebrate Purim and have dinner with the Rabbi's family. Can Rabbi Kaplan reveal the answer to one of the burning questions - why can't Jews eat bacon?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: A Swiss Italian television crew was in Kabul in the days leading up to the surrender and was able to document the growing anguish of a society that feels the end of a hope cultivated for twenty years. Social, civil and democratic achievements, especially those made by women, are being swept away. It is also the starting point for a reflection on the fight against terrorism.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Though separated by a stretch of sea, Glasgow and Belfast share elements of political, sporting and religious culture rooted in the difficult, unresolved events faced by the Irish community during the twentieth century. The Huddle tells the stories of two Irish communities brought together by a devotion to the Celtic Football Club, and a shared faith in football. Exploring the contradictions between two cities facing radical ideological divides yet brought together by full stadiums, these are the interwoven and personal accounts of journalists, musicians, political militants, IRA fighters—all united by their love of football—on what it means to be Irish.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Hand-to-hand combat, it is every soldiers greatest fear. At the Army Combatives School in Fort Benning, Georgia, they teach soldiers how to fight to survive. Teach them skills that are beyond UFC…skills that kill!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Trading in his city clothes and cell phone for a black hat and plain shirt, host Tevya goes off the grid into a world where technology is taboo and life is humble. Mennonites live without modern conveniences, drive horse and buggies and worship in their own devout yet simple ways. Can city-boy Tevya survive a cattle auction, farming by hand and a quilting circle?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: In the midst of a global epidemic that is still spreading , on the subtropical island of Taiwan , a group of seemingly ordinary but extraordinarily independent dancers showcase their disabled bodies in the natural scenery. As in normal daily life , their dance is the posture for life and the choreography is called "Vitality".

epg.programme_title_en: Late Night With Seth Meyers S14 #30
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《塞斯梅耶斯深夜秀》由艾美獎得主洛恩米高斯監製,邀請一線紅星作嘉賓,還有難忘的喜劇和最棒的音樂人.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Late Night with Seth Meyers is executive produced by the Emmy Award-winning Lorne Michaels and is home to A-list celebrity guests, memorable comedy and the best in musical talent.

epg.programme_title_en: The Tonight Show Starring Jimmy Fallon S14 #30
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 艾美獎及格林美獎得主兼喜劇演員吉米法倫以好客的訪問風格、觀眾投入度、精準的模仿和創新的短劇,將他獨特的高能爆笑喜劇引進NBC的60年傳奇系列.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Emmy and Grammy Award-winning comedian Jimmy Fallon brings his unique high-energy comedy to the storied 60-year NBC franchise with his welcoming interview style, love of audience participation, spot-on impersonations and innovative sketches.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一名富有寡婦的猝死讓調查人員困惑不已.隨著死因相互矛盾,加上牽涉數百萬財產,嫌疑逐漸指向她最親近的人.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A wealthy widows sudden death perplexes investigators. But with conflicting causes of death and millions at stake, suspicion falls on those closest to her.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一名馬廄看護表面上的自殺事件,在多年後因出現幾乎一模一樣的犯罪現場而遭到質疑,暗示可能有連環殺手在活動.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A horse groomers apparent suicide is called into question years later, when a near-identical crime scene suggests a serial killer may be at work.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Late Night with Seth Meyers is executive produced by the Emmy Award-winning Lorne Michaels and is home to A-list celebrity guests, memorable comedy and the best in musical talent.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 即將到來的比賽規則出現重大變動,強尼急忙為「鷹牙道館」尋找新學員.托莉不得不向拉魯索一家請求幫助.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A major change to the upcoming tournament sends Johnny scrambling to find a new recruit for Eagle Fang. Tory must ask a favor of the LaRussos.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 丹尼爾邀請安東尼加入宮城道,卻發現自己其實並不如想像中了解兒子.米格爾得知強尼與卡門之間的真相.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Daniel invites Anthony to join Miyagi-Do and discovers he doesnt know his son as well as he thought. Miguel learns the truth about Johnny and Carmen.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 米格爾與珊期待參加青少年舞會,卻因另一對情侶的突然出現而生變.泰瑞將強尼引誘至一個熟悉的地方.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Miguel and Sam are excited about attending the junior prom until another couple unexpectedly shows up. Terry lures Johnny to a familiar location.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一年一度的全谷空手道大賽正式展開,多個道館為總冠軍而戰,同時清算私人恩怨.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The annual All Valley Karate Tournament kicks off as several competing dojos vie for the grand championship - and settle some personal scores.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 比賽以震撼結局落幕,後續影響讓所有參賽者措手不及,兩位冠軍的未來充滿變數.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The tournament comes to a shocking end, with the aftermath leaving its participants reeling - and two champions facing uncertain futures.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 丹尼爾的新盟友(後轉為室友)考驗著阿曼達的耐心.米格爾在墨西哥尋找親生父親.泰瑞則開始對「眼鏡蛇道館」進行大改造.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Daniels new ally-turned-housemate tests Amandas patience. Miguel searches for his father in Mexico. Terry starts to transform Cobra Kai.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 喬善和丹尼爾策劃了一個針對泰瑞的冒險計畫.在墨西哥,羅比和強尼正在尋找米格爾,而米格爾發現了關於他父親的真相.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Chozen and Daniel hatch a risky plot against Terry. In Mexico, Robby and Johnny look for Miguel, who discovers the truth about his dad.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 丹尼爾過去的另一個敵人重新浮出水面.經過一天的 SPA 水療和一番內心掙扎後,珊對於她與米格爾的未來做出了決定.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Another enemy from Daniels past resurfaces. After a spa day and some soul-searching, Sam comes to a decision about her future with Miguel.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在《回到未來 III》中,馬蒂穿越回1885年,從亡命之徒手中救了博士.這部影片充滿了笑話、動作和感人肺腑的劇情,是這部備受喜愛的三部曲史詩般的西部大結局.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Back to the Future Part III, Marty travels to 1885 to save Doc from an outlaw. Packed with laughs, action, and heart, its the epic Wild West finale to the beloved trilogy.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 傑森船長與主廚本、黛西及若昂重聚,迎接來自《鹽湖城真實人妻》嘉賓的高壓首航.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: As Capt. Jason reunites with Chef Ben, Daisy and Joao for a high-pressure opening charter with The Real Housewives of Salt Lake City.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 隨著「人妻」們的衝突持續升溫,傑森船長保持距離,而廚房日益增長的壓力使主廚本與阿萊西亞產生了矛盾.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: As housewives drama continues to boil over, Capt. Jason keeps his distance while mounting pressure in the galley puts Chef Ben and Alesia at odds.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 傑森船長引入了匿名賓客意見卡,全體船員一同慶祝破紀錄的小費金額.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Capt. Jason introduces anonymous guest feedback cards and the crew celebrates a record-breaking tip.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 船員大洗牌激發了珍娜的嫉妒心,也讓主廚班在廚房裡分了心.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A crew shakeup fuels Jennas jealousy and distracts Chef Ben in the kitchen.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 主廚班因賓客的毒舌評論而大受打擊,他在廚房過度補償,並因無線電溝通不良與黛西發生衝突.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Reeling from harsh guest feedback, Chef Ben overcompensates in the galley and clashes with Daisy over radio miscommunication.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 當艾蕾西亞急忙想掩埋一則令人後悔的簡訊時,八卦散播的速度快到讓她無法招架.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: As Alesia scrambles to bury a regrettable text, gossip spreads faster than she can contain it.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 烤箱損壞迫使主廚班在極大壓力下,挑戰製作一套包含七道菜的晚餐.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A broken oven forces Chef Ben to attempt a seven-course dinner under extreme pressure.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 當主廚班與艾莉在緊張的晚餐服務中發生爭執時,傑森船長要求全體保持專業態度.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Capt. Jason demands professionalism when Chef Ben and Ellie clash through a tense dinner service.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廚房的和平是有代價的,主廚班推出了一項「親暱稱呼罰金制」以控制緊張局勢.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Peace in the galley comes at a price when Chef Ben introduces a pet-name penalty to keep tensions in check.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 儘管有艾蕾西亞在其中作梗,珍娜和艾迪最終還是回到了彼此的身邊.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jenna and Eddy find their way back to each other despite Alesias meddling.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在包船賓客留下驚喜禮物並提出大膽的「加碼小費」挑戰後離船,傑森船長終於准許船員們享受一場期待已久的假.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After charter guests depart with a surprise gift and a daring offer for extra tip money, Capt. Jason grants the crew a long-awaited day off.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 主廚班開始覺得黛西不再支持他了.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Chef Ben begins to feel Daisy no longer has his back.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 主廚班和珍娜試圖讓他們的曖昧關係更進一步,但艾迪的嫉妒和麥克的干擾卻成了絆腳石.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Chef Ben and Jenna try to take their flirtations to the next level, but Eddys jealousy and Mikes interference get in the way.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 新空服員(或二副/服務員)的到來讓珍娜的嫉妒心徹底爆發.黛西和艾莉因為鮮蝦沙拉發生的爭吵,讓主廚班夾在中間進退兩難.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The arrival of a new stew pushes Jennas jealousy into overdrive. A fight between Daisy and Ellie over shrimp cocktail puts Chef Ben in the middle.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一個不再是秘密的吻讓船上的關係陷入嚴重緊張,其後果導致一名船員被剝奪了階級徽章.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A not-so-secret kiss puts relationships onboard under serious strain, with consequences that leave one crew member stripped of their stripes.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一個不再是秘密的吻讓船上的關係陷入嚴重緊張,其後果導致一名船員被剝奪了階級徽章.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A not-so-secret kiss puts relationships onboard under serious strain, with consequences that leave one crew member stripped of their stripes.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在一名船員降職後,另一名船員爭取晉升.班大廚晉升艾莉的計劃引發了他與黛西之間的緊張關係.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the wake of one crew members demotion, another pushes for a promotion. Chef Bens plan to promote Ellie stirs tension with Daisy.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 傑森船長在最後一次航程前向各部門主管劃清界線.一位再次到訪的包船客人讓後廚團隊大感棘手.船員們依依惜別.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: When a series of brutal attacks on young women terrorizes the Twin Cities, detectives are taunted by a killer who repeatedly calls 911 to confess - forcing investigators into a desperate race to stop him before he kills again.

epg.programme_title_en: The Tonight Show Starring Jimmy Fallon S14 #33
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 艾美獎及格林美獎得主兼喜劇演員吉米法倫以好客的訪問風格、觀眾投入度、精準的模仿和創新的短劇,將他獨特的高能爆笑喜劇引進NBC的60年傳奇系列.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Emmy and Grammy Award-winning comedian Jimmy Fallon brings his unique high-energy comedy to the storied 60-year NBC franchise with his welcoming interview style, love of audience participation, spot-on impersonations and innovative sketches.

epg.programme_title_en: Late Night With Seth Meyers S14 #33
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《塞斯梅耶斯深夜秀》由艾美獎得主洛恩米高斯監製,邀請一線紅星作嘉賓,還有難忘的喜劇和最棒的音樂人.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Late Night with Seth Meyers is executive produced by the Emmy Award-winning Lorne Michaels and is home to A-list celebrity guests, memorable comedy and the best in musical talent.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 丹尼爾和強尼邀請了一位新教練來評估他們的學生.隨著爭奪「世界大會」席位的競爭白熱化,朋友變成了敵人.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Daniel and Johnny invite a new sensei to evaluate their students. Friends become foes as the competition heats up for a spot in the Sekai Taikai.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 宮城道館的頂尖學生們為了爭奪隊長之位展開對決,但一場毀滅性的悲劇改變了一切.克里斯揭曉了他最後的驚喜.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Miyagi-Dos top students square off to be team captains, but a devastating tragedy changes everything. Kreese reveals his final surprise.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 隨著「世界大會」的展開,一場背叛威脅到宮城道館隊的表現.極具戲劇性的第一場賽事帶來了意想不到的驚喜.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: With the Sekai Taikai underway, a betrayal threatens to throw team Miyagi-Do off their game. A dramatic first event unleashes the element of surprise.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 尋找宮城先生過去線索的過程讓丹尼爾陷入危險.米格爾對羅比的專注度提出質疑.珊在場外目睹了醜陋的行為.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The search for clues about Mr. Miyagis past leads Daniel into danger. Miguel raises doubts about Robbys focus. Sam observes ugly behavior off the mat.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一場個人危機深深震撼了米格爾和強尼.喬善和一名敵對教練聯手尋找他們的學生,卻意外發現了別的事物.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A personal crisis shakes Miguel and Johnny to the core. Chozen and a rival sensei team up to find their students - but discover something else instead.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在錦標賽的雙打淘汰賽中,誰能晉級下一輪:宮城道館還是眼鏡蛇道館?一個震驚的啟示擊碎了丹尼爾的世界.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Who will move to the next round in the tournaments tag team elimination match: Miyagi-Do or Cobra Kai? A shocking revelation shatters Daniels world.

epg.programme_title_tc: 奪寶大戰:受詛咒的聖盃
epg.programme_title_en: The Librarian: The Curse Of The Judas Chalice
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 因為在拍賣會上取得魔法的「賢者之石」而忽略女友,弗林・卡森因此被命令去度假.來到紐奧良後,他卻忙於保護「猶大聖杯」,並試圖阻止吸血鬼威脅世界.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Losing his girlfriend because he was at an auction getting the magical Philosophers Stone, Flynn Carsen is ordered to take a vacation. In New Orleans he finds himself busy protecting the Judas Chalice and saving the world from vampires.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一名馬廄看護表面上的自殺事件,在多年後因出現幾乎一模一樣的犯罪現場而遭到質疑,暗示可能有連環殺手在活動.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A horse groomers apparent suicide is called into question years later, when a near-identical crime scene suggests a serial killer may be at work.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一名休班警察撥打 911 報案,稱妻子昏迷不醒.隨著疑點逐漸浮現,所有懷疑都指向他可能涉案,但一個出乎意料的轉折,徹底改變了一切.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: An off-duty police officer calls 911 to report his wife unconscious. As suspicions mount that he may be to blame for her death, an unexpected twist changes everything.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一名馬廄看護表面上的自殺事件,在多年後因出現幾乎一模一樣的犯罪現場而遭到質疑,暗示可能有連環殺手在活動.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在一場前所未有的全球大流行疾病蹂躪地球後,資源變得極其匱乏,甚至必須以命相換.一位母親為了救活病重的女兒,不惜拼死一搏.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A mother fights to save the life of her ailing daughter after an unprecedented pandemic ravaged the planet, leaving resources so scarce you must pay for them with your life.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 丹尼爾和強尼將充滿歷史氣息的巴塞隆納作為隊長們的訓練場.但在準決賽中的一次陰險偷襲,引發了一場空前絕後的大混戰.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Daniel and Johnny use historic Barcelona as a training ground for their captains. But a cheap shot in the semifinals sparks a brawl to end all brawls.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 當學生們在規劃告別空手道後的生活時,丹尼爾和強尼因重振「世界大會」而發生衝突.克里斯則重新審視了他的指導原則.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: While their students plan for life after karate, Daniel and Johnny clash over reviving the Sekai Taikai. Kreese reconsiders his guiding principles.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 珊和羅比在為未來的挑戰進行訓練時,向朋友們尋求支持.強尼和卡門迎來了隊伍的新成員.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Sam and Robby turn to their friends for support as they train for the challenges ahead. Johnny and Carmen welcome a new addition to the team.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 當真相時刻來臨,丹尼爾和強尼勇敢面對過去.接著來到了戰鬥時間,羅比將在世界空手道錦標賽中對決阿塞爾.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: As the moment of truth arrives, Daniel and Johnny confront their pasts. Then its fight time as Robby battles Axel in the world karate championship.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一名劇作家沉迷於一張1912年美麗女演員的照片,並透過自我催眠穿越時空回到過去尋找她.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A playwright becomes obsessed with a photograph of a beautiful young actress from 1912 and travels back through time using self-hypnosis to find her.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 被賣入京都殘酷的娛樂區,一名少女學會了誘惑、虛榮與競爭,最終成為日本最傑出的藝妓.在華麗絲綢與白粉面具之下,藏著一場危險的生存遊戲,以及一場足以毀滅一切的禁忌之戀.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Sold into Kyotos ruthless pleasure district, a young girl masters seduction, vanity, and rivalries to become Japans supreme geisha. Beneath silk and powder lies a dangerous game of survival and a forbidden desire that could destroy it all.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 兩位昔日少林僧人好友,因卷入反叛政權的動亂而分道揚鑣.雄心勃勃者步步高升,成為權傾一時的軍官;而被背叛的朋友則修習太極之道,追尋內心的平靜與力量.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Two friends, ex Shaolin monks, part ways as they brush with the ongoing rebellion against the government. The ambitious one rises up to be a powerful military commander, while his betrayed friend resorts to learn the calm ways of Tai Chi.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 基努李維主演《47浪人》,這是一部史詩奇幻電影,講述一名被放逐的浪人加入武士行列,為了對抗殘暴的領主、尋求復仇與榮耀,在古代日本展開驚心動魄的旅程.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Keanu Reeves stars in 47 Ronin, an epic fantasy where an outcast joins samurai on a quest for vengeance and honor against a ruthless overlord in ancient Japan.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 1941年,轟炸東京後,一名美國飛行員在中國緊急降落.一位當地寡婦救了他,並冒著生命危險將他藏匿起來,以免他被日軍抓獲.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In 1941, after bombing Tokyo, a US pilot makes an emergency landing in China. A local widow rescues him and risks everything to hide him from Japanese forces.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 1937 年,一名中國武術家重返上海,發現師父遇害、武館遭日軍欺壓,於是挺身而出.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In 1937, a Chinese martial artist returns to Shanghai to find his teacher dead and his school harassed by the Japanese.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這部史詩級歷史劇講述了真實存在的貝都因人領袖奧瑪·繆克泰爾的故事.他在20世紀初英勇地率領利比亞本土抵抗軍,對抗墨索里尼統帥下殘暴且武器精良的義大利入侵軍隊.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: An epic historical drama depicting the real-life Bedouin leader Omar Mukhtar, who bravely leads the Libyan native resistance against the brutal, technologically superior forces of Benito Mussolinis invading Italian army in the early 20th century.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一位充滿希望的洛杉磯女演員與一位失憶女子結為好友.當她們共同尋找她身份的過程中,現實與幻覺交織,這是一場如夢似幻,關於野心,身份與好萊塢黑暗面的驚悚之旅.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A hopeful actress in Los Angeles befriends an amnesiac woman, and as they search for her identity, reality and illusion blur in a dreamlike thriller about ambition, identity, and Hollywoods dark side.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 阿諾史瓦辛格在魔鬼孩子王中飾演強悍的偵探約翰金布爾,他臥底成為一名教師,以尋找毒梟的妻子.這部經典的喜劇驚悚片充滿了動作,幽默和感人.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Arnold Schwarzenegger stars as tough detective John Kimble in Kindergarten Cop, going undercover as a teacher to find a drug lords wife. Packed with action, humor, and heart, its a classic comedy-thriller.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 查理為一隊差勁的小聯盟球隊擔任球童,期間懷疑一名球員被謀殺.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: While working as a ball girl for a bad minor league team, Charlie suspects foul play in the death of one of the players.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 查理被捲入中學課室的政治鬥爭,一場無傷大雅的才藝表演被一名學生與班級寵物有關的邪惡陰謀搶去焦點.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Charlie gets caught up in the politics of an elementary school classroom when a harmless talent show performance is upstaged by a students diabolical plot involving the class pet.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 霸巴和家人被背叛.肯恩女王以奸計應付新衝突.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Baba and family are betrayed. Queen Kane uses her cunning to face a new conflict.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一名男子被招募加入一個超自然間諜組織,海倫則在工作上遇到了麻煩.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Guy gets recruited to join a supernatural spy organization. Helen deals with trouble at work.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 蓋伊加入了塔拉馬斯卡,並被派往倫敦執行首次任務.海倫負責訓練他成為間諜.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Guy joins Talamasca and is sent to London on his first mission. Helen trains him to be a spy.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一名男子被招募加入一個超自然間諜組織,海倫則在工作上遇到了麻煩.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Guy gets recruited to join a supernatural spy organization. Helen deals with trouble at work.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Team Shibisu arrives to confront FUG member Jue Viole Grace. In order to prevent his former teammates from discovering that he is the 25th Bam, Viole takes on Team Shibisu.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 獲得登船證的參賽者們在阿基米德號上稍作休息.坤在船上與拉克重逢.他們決心從FUG手中奪回維奧萊(巴姆),「旗幟」工坊之戰終於打響!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The participants that acquired boarding passes enjoy a moments rest aboard the Archimedes. Khun is reunited with Rak on the floating ship. With their determination to take back Viole (Bam) from FUG, the Flag Workshop Battle finally begins!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 正當賽斯決定踏上新的旅程時,大量的復仇女神之卵如雨般落在了阿爾忒彌斯學院.城裡的魔法師攔截了這些卵,但漏掉了一顆,它落在了梅莉恰巧正在採蘑菇的小島上.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Just when Seth decides to set out on a new journey, a massive number of Nemesis eggs rains down on Artemis Academy. The sorcerers of the city intercept them, but an egg they miss falls on an island where Melie happens to be gathering mushrooms.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 賽斯回到家,把在與康拉德戰鬥時遇到的神秘男子的遭遇告訴了阿爾瑪,但阿爾瑪不相信.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Seth returns home and tells Alma of his encounter with the mysterious man during his battle with Konrad, but Alma isnt buying it.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 塞斯啟程前往首都,卻被一艘商人的飛艇攔截.多虧格林的幫助,塞斯才僥倖逃脫,並成功抵達首都,在那裡他遇到了道克和梅莉.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Seth sets out for the capital but gets intercepted by a Merchant-Baron airship. Seth barely escapes thanks to Grimm, and successfully reaches the capital where he encounters Doc and Melie.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 退休殺手法蘭克,人稱「沉默者」.想跟他的新女友和她女兒過上正常的生活,但黑手黨老大要他為年幼的女兒的死報仇,他身不由己地重出江湖.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Retired hitman, Frank, known as The Silencer wants to lead a normal life with his new girlfriend and her daughter but is unwillingly brought back into the game when a mafia mob boss wants him to avenge the death of his young daughter

epg.episode_synopsis_en: After attempting to enter the castles archives, Seth gets kicked out! Seth is later introduced to Ocoho and joins her in battle.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: The results of the individual tournament pit the two winning teams, Team Mad Dog and Team FUG, against each other in the Workshop Battle, while the losing teams advance to the training tournament. As their respective battles begin, Khun and Wangna...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 塞思僥倖逃出城堡,但身負重傷.梅莉察覺到賽斯有危險,便和醫生,奧科霍一起出發尋找他.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Seth narrowly escapes the castle, but is badly wounded. Melie senses that Seth is in trouble and heads out with Doc and Ocoho to search for him.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 奧科霍和梅莉因在上一場戰鬥中違抗命令而受到指責,但莫德雷德告訴女王這一切都是布朗戈爾領主的失誤,從而救了她們.同時,塞斯繼續訓練,以便學會控制自己的力量.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ocoho and Melie are blamed for disobeying orders in the previous battle, but Mordred saves them by telling the queen that it was all Lord Brangoires mistake. Seth, meanwhile, continues training so that he can learn to control his power.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 塞斯繼續接受米爾和吉爾的嚴格訓練,以期控制自己的力量.同時,面對即將到來的復仇女神威脅,騎士巫師們被迫接受德·吉利斯領主的援助,展開緊急行動.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Seth continues his rigorous training with Myr and Jill so that he can control his powers. Meanwhile, the Knight-Sorcerers are forced to accept the aid of Lord de Guilis during an emergency operation on an approaching Nemesis threat.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一場大風暴威脅到太平洋西北部,一家人必須找到彼此,並竭力在風暴席捲到他們失去控制並毀滅地球前將其制止!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: When a massive storm threatens the Pacific Northwest, a family must find each other and work together to put a stop to the storm before it spreads beyond their control and annihilates the planet!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 麥特戴蒙回歸,再次飾演傑森伯恩,保羅葛林格拉斯執導的神鬼認證:傑森包恩也將繼續上演驚險刺激的續集.伯恩被迫重出江湖,與艾莉西亞·維坎德,文森特·卡塞爾等眾多明星聯袂出擊,共同面對新的危機.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Matt Damon returns as Jason Bourne in Jason Bourne, with director Paul Greengrass back for another thrilling chapter. Bourne is drawn out of hiding, facing new dangers with Alicia Vikander, Vincent Cassel, and more.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Edos leadership is called into question. Baba and Haniwa meet a secret tribe of warriors known as The Compass.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: In a world where magic is waning and technology prevails, 15-year-old Jennifer Strange runs a magician employment agency and discovers the last dragon is being hunted.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Seth is still unable to control his rampaging power. He tries to suppress it, but only ends up closer to being completely engulfed by it. But by thinking about all the bonds and relationships hes forged up to this point, Seth experiences an awake...

epg.episode_synopsis_en: As the town bustles in preparation for the upcoming ordination ceremony, Ocoho leaves quietly, avoiding being seen. Lord Brangoire grows suspicious of her behavior and attacks her. Melie stops him, but is shocked by Ocohos actions!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 克裡斯和女友羅斯在她家的莊園共度週末.起初,熱情的歡迎似乎讓他們對跨種族關係感到尷尬--直到令人不安的真相浮出水面.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Chris joins his girlfriend Rose for a weekend at her familys estate. At first, their warm welcome seems like awkwardness about their interracial relationship-until disturbing truths emerge.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Inquisition invasion begins. Boudica puts up an impressive defense, but her knights are unable to break through the Fantasia Vacuum generated by the Inquisitions new machine.

epg.episode_synopsis_en:
Creating a brand-new interactive ATM that combined with puzzle solving and daily life! Guests can win money by taking three rounds of intellectual challenges from the ATM, turn wisdom into money!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: They’re beautiful - and deadly, with venomous spines that resemble a lion's mane. They’re lionfish, a tropical reef species normally found in the Indo-Pacific. Now, they’re wreaking havoc in the Caribbean and Atlantic – all thought to have descended from a handful of aquarium fish carelessly released into the sea. In these regions, they are potentially a greater threat to coral reefs and commercial fish populations than global warming or pollution.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: We delve into the world of flies, exploring ehtir annoying habits, vast numbers, and surprising benefits. From spreading diseases like malaria to playing vitalroles in nature, flies are more than just pests. Discover their fascinating behaviors, contributions to medical science, and unique adaptations that make them one of the most successful groups of insects.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: On this episode we travel from the desert, to the forest, Australia to Borneo and back to learn how species as diverse as Bat-eared Foxes, the Bilby, Deer, Kangaroo Rats, cicadas, Proboscis Monkeys and other creatures never miss an auditory trick.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: They’re not whales at all, but by far the largest fish in the sea. Yet at nearly 50 feet in length and weighing 20 tons or more, they eat only the smallest marine animals. They are not a threat to humans, but their numbers are dramatically shrinking. Like elephants slaughtered for their ivory tusks, whale sharks are relentlessly pursued by poachers. From Africa to Asia, they are targeted for their meat and immense fins.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Singing louder than any animal on earth, humpback whales are famous for their haunting songs and jaw-dropping acrobatics. They were hunted to the brink of extinction until a moratorium on killing them was implemented in the 1960s. But after finally rebounding in numbers, whaling nations are exploring ways to re-open the hunt. In Antarctica, Japan is targeting minke, fin, and now... humpbacks.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《生活圈》欄目全方位展現新時期中國人民的「新健康、新消費、新科技、新文化、新時尚」,以社會主義核心價值觀為引領,通過甄別媒體環境中與日常生活相關的各類資訊,引導觀眾掌握生活技巧、領悟生活智慧,宣導健康的生活方式和積極的生活態度。
《今日說法》是一檔日播法治欄目,秉持「點滴記錄中國法治進程」的理念,以「重在普法,監督執法,促進立法、服務百姓」為宗旨,採用「以案說法、大眾參與、專家點評」的節目樣式進行普法宣傳,被譽「中國人的法制午餐」。節目前半部分呈現記者深入基層採訪的真實案例,後半部分由演播室中的主持人和嘉賓對節目進行點評,體現節目品質和社會價值。

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 花向義提出分手，義卻仍不知自己錯在那裡，更要根打探。根發現花自分手後鬆口氣，義摸不著頭腦。義到按摩椅專門店哄花，但花卻不斷表示心意已決。此時，三妗婆突然來訪，催促二人婚期，他們唯有支吾而對。
小石、愁飛和溫柔來到碼頭，想從水路前進，巧遇船上的雷純，四人結交相談甚歡。三人下船後，愁飛藉詞把溫柔氣走，來到苦水鋪，見到蘇夢枕，不巧他正被六分半堂埋伏襲擊，小石和愁飛出手相助擊退敵人，三人結為好友。

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 肥媽教香港男生煮一道「氹女友大餐」，當心大家會因此「甜到惹蟻」！食米線都是氹女友招數？肥媽的米線用了鴨血漿去煮，再灑上芝士碎，與高級西式意粉無異！另一道「白汁煙肉菠菜」同樣西菜味濃，要更高層次，可煎一塊沾滿開心果碎的心形羊架，換取甜蜜時刻！六號自行動手準備蒸雞肉餅，為何最後還是要肥媽插手？如果男友願意花心思及時間，為你動手製作「抹茶豆腐Tiramisu」，足可證明他的濃厚愛意！
運輸及物流局積極推動本港的海空聯運，節目《航向未來》由星級藝員吳偉豪、郭柏妍擔綱演出，並飾演初到海運前線的實習生，透過實況情節，介紹當局如何精準高效地協調貨船泊進港口後，把船上貨物經香港轉運出海，繼而運往世界各地，同時為國際航運業綠色減碳出力。

epg.programme_title_tc: 滙豐卓越理財呈獻:卓越滙談[粵]
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 累積財富後如何令家庭及子女的未來更有保障？滙豐卓越理財《卓越滙談》聚焦四大主題，涵蓋財富管理、環球升學、家庭健康、旅遊及時尚品味禮遇，結合專業觀點，提供實用資訊讓觀眾更全面規劃未來。

心臟科醫生指心臟血管阻塞分為慢性與急性，除了依賴搭橋手術治療，人體亦可能會透過「側支循環」自建新供血渠道，繞過阻塞位置，留意醫生詳析相關資訊。香港滾軸溜冰小將李悅意、趙奭孜聯同教練受訪，分享登上世界巔峰的熱血歷程。兩人自四、五歲已接觸這運動，沉醉於箇中帶來的速度感，及挑戰自我精神。她們分別在花式繞樁與速度過樁項目榮登「世一」，同對佳績感到光榮和喜悅。「睇餸食飯」，Annie師傅示範「原粒豆豉雞」。
阮政峰自信地跟陳華鑫(金金)分享心得，認為出色甜品師必須將「味覺」和「嗅覺」訓練到極致。古嘉俊(古Sir)提議兩人來個「嗅覺」大測試，兩人能否成功通過？古Sir示範「柚子焦糖冧酒牛奶朱古力」，皆因柚子和焦糖是上佳配搭，但煮焦糖要留意甚麼？他還講解今次做朱古力餡為何棄用魚膠粉？兩位「同學仔」在製作「朱古力外殼」時，古Sir懊惱大嘆「十級混亂」，情況有多狼狽？他又無奈勸喻金金從「幼兒班」重新學起！

epg.programme_title_en: The Learning Curve Of A Warlord#7[Can][PG]
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 天嬌自小在妓院長大，她埋怨狄奇不讓為人妻的她一起共患難，狄奇感動，帶她走時遭妓院老闆根本英俊刁難。羅義到歌廳接艾妞回大帥府，艾妞打算重投大同懷抱而拒絕，豈料大同已把她忘記。羅義為救艾妞中刀，艾妞自責紅顏禍水。落蘆將少帥帶回大帥府，仍不肯做狄奇軍師，狄奇放出誘餌令他乖乖留下。翌晨，落蘆指出昇威鎮的防守問題，喚醒狄奇要去先根的祿豐鎮搶地盤。此時細龜、佘南為瓜分祿豐鎮而爭拗，狄奇出現要分一杯羮，結果……

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 小丸子摘了秋櫻回家，爺爺帶她去買花瓶，但因為不夠錢作罷，小丸子於是把汽水瓶拿回去插花。小玉因被父親纏著拍照而煩惱，小丸子建議讓他去找其他拍攝對象，最終把目標定為鎮上的老人家。
這次「童Ai畫出界」故事接龍以「原始森林中的小恐龍」為主題，四位小朋友分別讓AI生成頑皮、懶惰、善良、活潑性格特徵的恐龍，哪隻會當選成為主角？不過，檢視AI生成影片時，眼利的孩子卻發現小恐龍變成了「有三隻手」的穿崩情況。「我和動物的難忘體驗」，小朋友投稿「開心Share」與狗隻、馬匹、蜥蝪的快樂時光；Tiffany姐姐則溫馨公開和愛犬的日常片段。皓誼姐姐談到喜歡爬蟲類動物，讓身旁的拍檔一臉驚訝。
美月拾到一本筆記，物主是朱莉亞的室友六堂詠瑠。從筆記中，美月得知近期當紅的偶像公主小說，作者的真正身分就是詠瑠。在美月交還筆記時，詠瑠透露自己擁有偶像公主手環，卻怯於上台表演，所以才選擇寫小說。
緊貼市況，逢交易日下午5時50分報道當日本港和外圍股市行情，以及重點財經新聞。

TVB 59周年台慶騷的開場序幕，邀得「三屆視帝」羅嘉良獻唱，眾後輩頓成小粉絲！壓軸表演嘉賓則有許志安，藉金曲掀起回憶殺！MYNT魔音女團於台慶夜跳唱新歌，成員自評表現。「東張女神盃」賽跑由李旻芳勝出，獲丈夫黃耀英送上祝賀。台慶大抽獎環節，「中聲」顏志恆獨得45萬元，感受如何？另外，有車主在商場停車場停泊時，車輛遭天花滴下夾雜油脂的污水弄染。停車場職員、管理處卻要求車主自行與疑似源頭的餐廳索償？

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 龔喜遭電騙集團騙去巨款，報警後銀行戶口暫時被凍結。她本想向姐夫高修借錢，惟高修派冠一赴約，令她難以啓齒。嘉冰答應暫代支付各項開支，並趁機教龔喜學習節儉美德。唐芯帶二人到超市享用免費試食，卻因與《當年好聲音》對手MOMO狹路相逢惹出風波；龔喜與嘉冰到名店，打算以唐芯傳授的奇招「免費」購置新衣，怎料再次橫生枝節……得不償失。連串慳錢計劃失敗，嘉冰開銷大增，日常伙食亦成問題，唐芯再獻慳錢妙計……

epg.programme_title_tc: 保誠保險呈獻：玫瑰戰爭#9[粵][PG]
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 德龍往找無雙，帶來線索佐證安安所言非虛，二人決定聯手追查真相。《玫瑰》開拍情慾戲，素希到片場向菲雅示威，菲雅帶着不忿與德龍在鏡頭前激烈演出。雲生着綺雲設法令安安噤聲。安安信任綺雲，透露掌握子盈死亡真相的關鍵佐證片段，綺雲提出收購；綺雲派黎叔的手下馮志健與安安交收USB。安安遇上嚴重意外，USB輾轉落入無雙手中，無雙看後震撼……另邊廂，無雙向綺雲直言安安的意外是鳳儀所為……

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 望遠市場以高CP值美食見稱，如風依網片路線掃街，卻被新鮮鱈場蟹吸引，差點遺忘「搵食」任務！糖餅獲評首選美食，如風深入地下室一探虛實。即叫即炸辣椒內有乾坤；幕後人員挑戰勁辣無骨炸雞，辣到手震！藉年糕排骨中和刺激感，但內裡不含年糕，也非排骨？最後以抵食可樂餅作結，如風滿足到帶來惡搞表演……非一般「超市」充滿驚喜，各款蔬果竟是造型公仔，番薯、粟米卻是麵包？飽肚後轉戰時尚服飾熱點，如風示範「購物燒脂法」。
媚娘被囚掖庭，韋妃派人滅口；青梅竹馬李牧闖獄救她。世民查其身分，李牧憑偽造背景過關，媚娘則開始追查逼宮疑點。

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 經過一夜纏綿，玉麟及忠正變得恩愛異常。承康因請帖之事趕至守言家，忠正無情地指摘他，並讓守言等人試飲「天下無雙酒」。承康知道再也瞞騙不下，唯有說出「天下無雙酒」之來歷，眾人均表同情，忠正亦由玉麟口中得知，承康為撮合他倆，盡了不少綿力，想盡辦法取消試酒惜不成功。忠正於是運用騙術，使眾人將分得之「天下無雙酒」，暫存於木箱內，欲趁機挾酒私逃，免承康聲譽受損。豈料其舉動被黑衣人一一監視，忠正及顧井陷入險境。
